chapters.title: Chapter 1930
paragraphs: Hecate's eyes pulsed with wonder and power as she saw her new Master.
His body transformed as he became taller and more imposing, a demonic air whipping around the surroundings as Hecate felt the surge of a powerful Bloodline!

It didn't give off the same feel as a Dimensional Royal Bloodline, and yet it had the same intensity as the man adorned in an Armament of swirling Realities had Obsidian wings erupt from his back, his hair becoming dyed entirely black as two horns rose from his head and pointed to the skies sharply.

Between the two horns, dark flames came to be as they formed into a spinning crown of Obsidian flames, his whole face becoming immensely more devilish as it held a demonic charm that could put even the most mesmerizing Incubus to shame!

This was because even though the Arch Demon Lord Transformation was not able to display its boosts like before as its authority just wasn't enough in this stage of Reality, it still held the inmate abilities of the Absolute Sin that included all of the Seven Deadly Sins. It still had within it the Sin of Lust.
His demonic nature could not be denied as Hecate Eranelon felt like she was standing in front of a Daemon Royal!
"Master...I do not know too much about you as I have many thoughts and aspirations, but not enough knowledge on how to best put them to use. Could you enlighten me just a little about yourself?"
Her eyes were dripping with interest as she asked, Noah waving his index finger as his will formed a ball of memories and information about him that most of his Vassals would know.
This ball of light flowed into her mind as when it did...
She closed her eyes briefly, only to open them soon after and release a cry of disbelief as she breathed out deeply while gazing at him.
"The Tyrannical Emperor...the Quintessential Kainos Emperor!"
Such titles caused Hecate Eranelon to tremble as she realized just the sheer gravity of the being she bound herself to!
If she could guide him in the Apollyon Dimension...not just the Daemon Orc Ravine, but the vast domains of Dimensional Rulers might be a possibility.
For the one she had bound herself to actually have the title that corresponded to the current Age...anything was possible as Hecate's eyes shone with glory and Destiny.

"Then Master...you already have a rousing will of Tyranny as to thrive in this Dimension, you have to truly act in a manner of hellish tyranny that borders near overbearing. Display anywhere you go that when you arrive, other Emperors lose their qualifications."
WAA!
As she spoke, her crimson wings buzzed as her curvaceous body glowed with light, the Essence of the Decretum of Apollyon buzzing around her as she unexpectedly took on an admonishing tone!

"And I mean hellish tyranny in all aspects, Master. Like currently- you have a Golden Succubus that also holds the Bloodline of a Dimensional Royalty who has just submitted herself to you...why have you not swallowed her up yet? You will benefit to gain a semblance of a Royal Dimensional Physique and attain the momentary boosts of a Golden Succubus. Let your reservations free and take what is right in front of you first, then after you are refreshed...I shall present to you the Rosebud Domain that my father rules."
Her words truly turned admonishing as she stood straight and actually tested the tyranny of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor!
"Hellish Tyranny, huh?"
BOOOM!

The vessel they were on trembled as a domain erupted to envelop everything, Noah's mesmerizing obsidian-winged demonic figure walking towards the crimson-winged Hecate who couldn't help but blink her eyes multiple times in a short time period, hoping that she didn't provoke her new Master too much as there was much to be done!

The Quintessential Kainos Emperor made a move towards a Dimensional Royalty as unlike what he expected, the weaving of destiny was unpredictable as it wasn't Katelyn that he would manage to test the concepts of Dual Cultivation when it came to Dimensional Physiques and what their boons would be.
It would instead be a new helper that had just bound herself to him as she was even bold enough to try and rouse him in a bid to have him act in a more tyrannical manner.

He would begin showing glimpses of his tyranny here as after this...there was a domain of the Lineage of Golden Succubi Daemons awaiting him as the ultimate enemy in the short term would be the Mad Orc Daemon Commander that was at the peak Ultima Strata!

A golden book still floated before Noah's main body as the events in the small corner of the Apollyon Dimension unfolded, his will observant on how unique the effects of Dual Cultivation would be and what he would gain from a Dimensional Royalty.

<It is just like any other form of Reality altering advancement. Across the myriad of Races and existences, some gear their progression by focusing on absorbing and assimilating the Essence of their surroundings to the extremes, others specialize in devouring the strength of others, and others rely on natural treasures. You forged the Resplendent Treasure Emperor concept to allow you to devour the strength of others in a multiplication fashion, others like the Universal Emperor Slike simply absorb the Origins of their enemies to attain their power, with Orc Daemons and many of those in the Apollyon Dimension actually being similar in nature.>
Lavalliere spoke out for the first time since her silence after Noah made his choice as she continued.

<Brutality and destruction thrive in the Apollyon Dimension as the Decretum of Apollyon rewards destruction, with the bodies of one's enemies being taken as boons and devoured for the Dimensional Races to refine their power even more. Some races like the Orc Daemons and Golden Succubi Daemons focus on the aspect of Lust as a method of progression to get stronger, with the concept of Dual Cultivation being just like your multiplicative loot attainment...just another Reality altering method of Progression. With you stacking so many methods of progression in your path, of course you will be immensely faster than others.>
WAA!

<But in this case, there is an intimate interplay of essence as if you can achieve harmony during it, the progression of both of your Aspects of Existence would be even faster. And the nature of Succubi allows them to benefit from this the most as this Hecate Eranelon should benefit more from this encounter, even if you are able to attain a Dimensional Physique from this.>
Lavalliere expanded on the workings of Dual Cultivation as Noah nodded lightly, giving more thought into it as at the end...
"Maybe I can forge a Keystone Ascendant Skill Tree, Edict, or REIFIED ability geared towards this to obtain the most out of it..."
He just came up with more possibilities for even more optimization!
But as this was underway, his eyes came to focus on the loot he could obtain naturally from Alpha Strata LEGENDS as he had yet to even open the pristine Obsidian Tier Randomized Loot Crates.
Just how effective would things like the Grotto Panaceas be in helping to saturate his First Dimensional Layer?

[<Grotto Panacea>:: A loot for all purposes. It holds within it the pure natal essence that births reality singularities. After coming to fruition from the Increased Loot Quality and Quantity of the Resplendent Treasure Emperor, it pronounces itself as one the highest ranking top tier loot under him. A single Grotto Panacea has the distinction of an Ultimate Limit Breaking Tool as an existence in the Firmaments of Ascendancy can utilize it to exceed their foundations and break their Limits in one Aspect of Existence- this feat only applicable once on any existence as taking more Grotto Panaceas thereafter will not have the effect of Limit Breaking. As it is a Panacea, it is usable at any stage of life from those who cannot utilize Mana to those grasping the Natural Laws of Reality. If the purpose is not to break one's limits in the Firmaments of Ascendancy, a single one is capable of allowing a smooth absorption of its essence to bring one from whatever stage they are on all the way to the peak of the Firmaments of Ascendancy...]

[...The absorption of 2 Grotto Panaceas will allow one to liquefy their Primogenial Strata, with 3 Panaceas allowing the crystallization of the Beta Strata. 4 Panaceas allow for the ionization of the Alpha Strata as 5 Panaceas will grant allow for the birth of the Ultima Strata. 500 Panaceas will make way for the formation of a Grotto Haven. In the context of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor, a single Panacea is capable of forging 3 Trillion Kainos Dimensional Cosmos and expanding your Dimensional Layer slightly. The formation of 100 Trillion Dimensional Cosmos will signify the saturation of a Dimensional Layer as a single Grotto Panacea can be utilized to begin the formation of the next layer whenever the prerequisite of the next Dimensional Essence is met. The Grotto Panacea tells the Quintessential Kainos Emperor to remain steadfast and butcher more Alpha and Ultima Strata existences if he wishes to obtain more of it, with the existence of RUINATION not being enough to replicate it at its current stage. Current Grotto Panaceas- 5>

chapters.title: Chapter 1931
paragraphs: The appearance of a Grotto Panacea was alarming and fantastical as just its description alone was unique from others!
It gave off a great deal of information, but none was as crucial as the fact that Noah needed 100 Trillion Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos to get close to saturating his first Dimensional Layer.
There was also the expansion of the Golden plane-like earthen layer as this treasure was something that could produce beautifully visible results towards Noah's path of progression!

Currently, he had been undergoing the slow and arduous process of birthing more Cosmos and expanding his Dimensional Layer with False Grotto Nacres- but his newly designed Realm retained its truth that it would be harder to raise and force than anything else as even after a few mountains of this loot were devoured, Noah had only managed to return to 14 Trillion Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos.
The loot of 5 Grotto Panaceas from 10 Alpha Strata LEGENDS would be capable of granting 15 Trillion more Cosmos as Noah's speed of progression would shoot up once more!
"Good, what about the rest?"

His will was brilliant as the life force of the Preponderant Irminsul surged in the surroundings, the golden book still monitoring the waves of destiny before him as he turned his attention towards the other two new forms of Loot.

<Empyral Physique Refining Pearl>:: A considerably powerful loot in the hands of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor that only sits below the Grotto Panacea. A single Pearl is capable of suffusing into your Bones, Organs, and Musculature to aid in their transformation to EMPYRAL, with any Physiques in the process of being forged having their progression increased by 10,000%. It can also be considered a Limit Breaking Tool as while it does not guarantee it- if one cannot make a breakthrough in the Aspect of the Body while consuming this, they should give up on the path of power. In the context of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor, a single Empyral Physique Refining Pearl is capable of aiding in the completion of Cycles of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique, with the hard to progress Cycles after the 30th Cycle requiring only 10 Empyral Physique Refining Pearls to be completed. Similar to the Grotto Panacea, this treasure currently cannot be replicated under RUINATION as the blood and bones of Alpha and Ultima Strata existences must be ground down to pave way for its descent...

< Ionized Soul Sea>:: A considerably powerful loot in the hands of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor that only sits below the Grotto Panacea. It is an expansive and formless sea of Ionized pure soul power that can aid in the Limit Breaking of the aspect of the Soul. The stronger the soul, the greater the perception and understanding of concepts one can achieve. The crystallization and ionization of one's soul benefit from the Grotto Panacea, but the supplementation of the Ionized Soul Sea is most effective as it strengthens the resonance between your Aspects of Existence and allows this process to occur even faster.

<Dimensional Resource Points>:: An amalgamation of authority stemming from the 9 Dimensions. The Dimensional Resource Points can be utilized to form new types of Skill Trees geared towards Dimensions, or they can be burned into your soul to help elevate the understanding of a Decretum of a Dimension.
"Well now..."
The immaculate branches of the Preponderant Irminsul vibrated powerfully.

The new loot promised utmost wonders as while the Empyral Physique Refining Pearls and Ionized Soul Seas were stupendous, the Dimensional Resource Points...these were something else entirely as there was a possibility of exploding Noah's authority and power with them!
They had the capability to increase one's understanding of the Decretum of a Dimension.
For one to grasp this, they had to first understand what a Decretum entailed!
For this, Noah pulled up the description of the Decretum of Dreams that should have been quantified sufficiently for now.

[<Decretum of Dreams>:: An extremely high authority stemming from the Dream Dimension. Sitting above Edicts and equaling only the Natural Laws of Reality, merely being capable of commanding this authority puts you at a higher stage compared to others. Grasping any understanding in a Decretum is immensely arduous as one has to normally live and be nourished in the specific Dimension for many years, understanding its mysteries over time and eventually commanding it themselves. The Decretum of Dreams is unique in its effects as with your slight understanding, you can utilize it to call forth a Domain of Dream Essence to reject other Decretums or Natural Laws of Reality. The Decretum can also be infused into abilities as they can be bolstered in unique ways, with the most powerful augmentation of abilities coming to fruition when one is proficient enough in the Decretum to the point that they can utilize Absolute Dream Authority...]

[...The essence of this Decretum can further be infused into Relics or Concepts to birth HERESY- a powerful distinction as concepts bathed under this Decretum gain significant authority. Further uses and understanding of the Decretum are being extrapolated as the current understanding of this Decretum is at .65%. Current Boosts granted to you through this understanding- 6.5% Augmentation to True Damage Values, True Defense Values, and True Vitality Values. Every time you fall into a slumber, there is a 6.5% chance to experience the Dream of the Oneiric that allows you to delve into the dreams and Realities of the possible immediate past and futures of selected targets. Be careful in your selection as if it is someone who is highly proficient in a Decretum or Natural Law, there is a chance of them perceiving you unless you hold a higher understanding...>]
The Decretum of Dreams was robust as Noah gazed at its wondrous details while voicing out.
"Assign 50 Dimensional Resource Points to the Decretum of Dreams."
BZZZT!
Authority and Essence surged into an abstruse authority as Noah observed the results.
From .65% understanding...
<Current understanding of the Decretum of Dreams- .70%>

chapters.title: Chapter 1932
paragraphs: The understanding of the Decretum of Dreams surged from .65% to .70% as a single Dimensional Resource Point was equivalent to .001% understanding in a Decretum!

The number may seem immensely low, but just the sheer fact that Noah could tulips this brute method of progression showed fantastic promise as this method...would be something that could allow him to catch up to the Dimensional Rulers and Dimensional Hellion Rulers that had been understanding the Decretum of Dreams for countless millions of years.

He was proceeding forward smoothly as just an entrance into the Apollyon Dimension was already paying off within minutes, his Will surging powerfully and gazing at the weaving of destiny as he thought of how to extend his advantages even further and obtain droves of loot like the Grotto Panaceas and Dimensional Resource Points.

The focus and spotlight came down onto the Grotto Panacea once more as after calculating and Illuminating countless paths before him...Noah made his choice as he sent a question to his Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.
"What is the progress with the Infinite Dream Automatons..."

<The 18 leading Automatons have broken all three Limits of the Aspects of Existence as they are currently establishing their Realities. Dozens more Automatons have begun their production as the same number of Triple Limit Breaker Automatons should be produced after another 24 hours.>
The ridiculous weapons Noah was working on on the side.

Autonomous creatures born from the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality whose entire power and Realm could be transferred onto any of his Vassals...these existences that were easiest to raise in the whole Infinite Reality were what Noah thought of first when he grasped the ridiculous Grotto Panaceas!
5 Panaceas were enough to bring an Alpha Strata LEGEND into Ultima.
For the best use of these Grotto Panaceas at this moment in time...Noah felt like it wasn't actually for himself as he could bring forth an even quicker and more astounding result another way!
And that way was with an Infinite Dream Automaton.
They were the easiest to raise as they could be optimized in shocking ways...and Noah had full control of them as they could later even hand down all their power and Realm to whoever he chose!
His eyes flashed with might and power as he waves his hands while speaking out.
"Focus on a single Dream Automaton. Spend all the current resources to quickly elevate it from Primogenial Strata into Alpha Strata...and be ready for the Utilization of an Ultima Strata Automaton."
WAA!

Shocking commands left Noah as a few mountains of False Grotto Nacres, Liquified Soul Seas, and Physique Refining Pearls were transferred to be used by the Infinite Reality- Noah even sending 20 Ionized Soul Seas and Empyral Physique Refining Pearls there as this matter was of utmost importance!

This was because he wouldn't be able to fully saturate his First Dimensional Layer until possibly after a day or two depending on his movements in the Apollyon Dimension and if any nearby Domains in the Dream Dimension were alerted to the Absolute Kainos Dream Dungeon.

This alone was ridiculous enough as it was a feasibility in a mere few days, but the rising of a Dream Automaton who already had all the resources? Where Noah could pack as many TABOO Edicts as it could handle and optimize it with any Skill Trees he chose?
Destiny surged around him in a maddening fashion as it told him this wouldn't even take a few hours.
With the advent of the Grotto Panaceas...bringing to light an Ultima Strata combatant under Noah that was a triple Limit Breaker was just a matter of time now!

And when he commanded an Automaton with such power...the average Ultima Strata Golden Incubus Eranelon overseeing the Rosebud Domain and the peak Ultima Strata existence that was the Mad Orc Daemon Commander Stephon...Noah would not worry about meeting them too soon as when conflict broke, an Ultima Strata Dream Automaton would return back to Noah everything he had invested into it and more!
So essence exploded out as this was placed in focus.
As for the Dual Cultivation session in the Apollyon Dimension...
<Resonance of Nature reacts to the connection and oscillation of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor and his partner.>

chapters.title: Chapter 1933
paragraphs: At the depths of the Dimensional Holy Land, above a sandy golden plane with fantastical Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos swirling above.
The body of a single Dream Automaton floated in a golden space as seas of loot constantly surged into it.

17 other similar-looking Automatons had smaller portions of loot surging around them in the distance as their bodies that gave off a crystalline metallic sheen while sharp weaponized hands that looked like sickles glimmered dangerously with power that could tear apart space.
The shoulders of these sharp appendages ended in a round oval shape as they floated grandly- connected to the oval Main body by a thin golden line that connected all its smooth metallic body parts!

The oval head of the isolated Automaton that floated above the whole body silently had changed as apart from the emotionless slits of eyes, a crown shone Resplendently above it as it read <DAEDALUS AUTOMATON> grandly.

This was a Triple Limit Breaker metallic existence that was currently infused with 10,000 TABOO Nomological Edicts, with 120 Obsidian Halos hidden within its body as above it the allure of 50 Infinite Reality Passages could already be seen!

The most powerful Geniuses Noah had come across so far were beings like Katelyn and Akaris who were Dual Limit Breakers, and this Automaton far exceeded them as after stabilizing in the Primogenial Strata, the Infinite Reality continued to focus all given resources to it as its false liquified soul that had resonated with all Aspects of Existence was the first to be stimulated- everything else following behind it.

Within its ovoid body, the allure of a Reality could be seen as new Cosmos constantly formed with the Aspects of Existence shining when the number of Cosmos neared 25 Trillion as the false soul of the Automaton began to undergo crystallization!

The vast golden sea was hardening all around as in a short period of time, it turned into beautiful crystalline structures that still perfectly bound and held together the resonated Aspects of Existence.
Beta Strata!
WAA!
Essence surged as emotionlessly, the Infinite Reality continued the same process.
Dazzling <Ionized Soul Seas> and <Empyral Physique Refining Pearls> appeared and surged into it silently.

Minutes passed as the processes of sublimation and ionization occurred at the same time, the crystallized solid particles of the soul becoming faster and faster as it began to turn gaseous and go towards becoming plasma!
The number of Cosmos within its singular Reality also reached 100 Trillion as soon after....
HOONG!
Booming waves of essence surged out as a circular golden blast emanated from this emotionless Automaton as it attained the Alpha Strata.
The Infinite Reality gazed at it silently as spatial waves fluctuated.
Soon after, blinding multicolored light bloomed as one of the most powerful loot under Noah was taken out.
Radiant in color and as vast as the Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos spinning above, a massive flower whose petals were formed from rivers of realities came out.

Its Reality petals seemed innumerable as they shone with incandescent beauty, a blinding light clustered at the center of all these petals as 4 more just like it appeared soon after to surround the figure of the Infinite Dream Automaton.
5 Grotto Panaceas to produce an Ultima Strata existence rotated around the golden Automaton as the wings of light behind its back glimmered wondrously.
Its emotionless eyes opened with a blinding light as the Grotto Panaceas unfurled!

The glorious body of the Arch Demon Lord stretched side to side as Noah gave a contented sigh, a domain he had enacted and imposed the 1:20,000 time ratio of the Infinite Reality disappearing at this time as the figure of a radiant Golden Succubus could also be seen behind him.

She seemed more powerful as shockingly, she was not of the Beta Strata anymore as after the passage of a mere hour in the outside Dimension and the passage of 20,000 hours within the isolated domain- she had achieved the Alpha Strata from the Dual Cultivation session!

It was in the nature of Succubi and Incubi to have a faster elevation in power when they controlled lust and everything to do with it, but this result was just unbelievable as even while looking weary, Hecate Eranelon continued to affirm it multiple times.
"Master, you might need to obtain more Dimensional Princesses and Queens and form a harem...I do not think I alone will be sufficient."
Hecate spoke seriously as she felt the foreign circulation of Dream Essence and the beginnings of a Physique she didn't fully grasp as she thought back to the last 20,000 hours.
Her gains were ridiculous as she couldn't fathom how, but Noah's Origin that was a Dimensional Reality contained more essence and power within it than any existence in the Alpha Strata!

Every time they were connected and underwent a feedback of essence between each other, the burst that Hecate received allowed for trillions of Cosmos to form constantly as thereafter, it was only the strengthening of her remaining Aspects of Existence before she broke through from peak Beta and to the Alpha Strata Realm!

This was also the method Noah was utilizing to ridiculously elevate the power of Adelaide, Barbatos, Athena, Valentina, Anna, Elena...and a few others as they had already broken one of their Limits in this manner.
The ways of elevating strength and power were unique in the vast Realities and Dimensions as Noah's ways were simply ridiculous.
It was different with Hecate Eranelon as she held Innate Physiques and Dimensional Bloodlines as even though she had benefited stupendously from Noah...his own benefits were not little!
The prompts were as always, glorious to see.
<The VENERABLE Prime Apollyon Igneous Daemon Dimensional Bloodline has been attained.>
<The Quasi-VENERABLE Golden Incubus Bloodline has been attained.>
<Due to the strong connection and its length, the full Mythical Natural Born Apollyon Physique has been attained.>
The results were stupendous as this wasn't all!
On top of attaining a Venerable Dimensional Bloodline and an Innate Dimensional Physique...a reaction had occurred when they bloomed inside his body!

chapters.title: Chapter 1934
paragraphs: The Bloodline of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor was already trying to surge past VENERABLE.
It had attained the Preponderant Irminsul Dimensional Bloodline as now, a brilliant Prime Apollyon Igneous Daemon Dimensional Bloodline had also appeared as its effects...
<The Quintessential Kainos Emperor absorbs the Aspects of the Prime Apollyon Igneous Daemon and the Golden Succubus Dimensional Bloodlines.>
<The path past VENERABLE becomes clearer.>
BZZT!
Bubbling Bloodline power surged around Noah as new possibilities and forms became accessible to him!
His Arch Demon Lord gradually changed as the horns became painted crimson gold, the fiery flaming throne above his head enlarging and letting off fiery Bloodline authority.

His body became even more robust underneath the DHARMA Relic Gravitational Reality Armament as his wings became surrounded by constantly burning golden flames, his face becoming even more handsome and devilish as his Tri-Pupiled eyes surged with demonic light!
<The Mythical Natural Born Apollyon Physique is being absorbed by the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique as it undergoes evolution.>
<The number of Infinite Reality Passages that can be withstood by a single cycle of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique has been increased to 6.>
WAA!
A fundamental change also bloomed for Noah's Physique as from gaining slots for 3 Infinite Reality Passages per cycle, he could now attain 6!
Multiple mountainous Reality Passages began to form the moment this prompt rose as they wanted to make their way past 100.

This was the most immediate effect of the absorption of another Dimensional Royal Physique as any other changes were still being quantified- with Noah always receiving feedback that they would be similar to the abilities he could utilize in the Dream Dimension as they would now be applicable to the Apollyon Dimension too!
Slow and steady.
Well, not really slow- but Noah was steadily rising and optimizing his power even more as mind you...this was just after an hour passed since he entered the Apollyon Dimension.
Now...there was Conquest of Dimensional Domains that remained!
Noah collected his thoughts as towards Hecate Eranelon's very serious assertion that she didn't think she would be sufficient for him and for him to obtain a harem of Dimensional Royalties...

"Well, there's already a harem that isn't too small." Noah replied with a smile as he appreciated the beauty and majesty of his Arch Demon Lord form that he wanted to term as his official Daemon form.
Hecate nodded as if she expected it, her crimson wings expanding as she still asserted seriously.
"Then the Master may need to double or triple the current Harem."
Dangerous words came out of her mouth with seriousness as Noah only shook his head with a devilish smile while causing surges of spatial essence to wrap around them.
"If need be. For now, let us see the Rosebud Domain and whether it has the strength to withstand the enraged Mad Orc Daemon Commander..."
SHIING!

The spatial essence wrapped around them as with the memories from those he killed and Hecate herself, Noah chose to instantly teleport towards the Boundary of the Rosebud Domains to tour the first lands that were vaster than any Kingdoms or Domains he had come across!
The number of Dimensional creatures in this domain alone toppled trillions as it was part of the lands that had been occupied for countless years in this powerful Dimension.
And he wanted to put it all under him as with Conquest, there would be the rise of the True Stars of Conquest.
There would be more tools for Empowerment!

And with the countless existences in a Dimension...Noah wanted to get as many as possible as he planned to move with care to not alert the Dimensional Rulers and two Dimensional Hellion Rulers too quickly- especially the one whose will he had decimated once.
He would move under another title in this Apollyon Dimension.
As the spatial essence that had wrapped around them dissipated, Noah's voice echoed out while a new scene painted itself before their eyes.
"Hecate, as we move...I shall take on the identity of the Daemon of Tyranny."
WAA!

"Yes, Master." The cunning eyes of a Dimensional Royalty shone as she bowed and nodded to her Master- an existence who came to the bounds of the Rosebud Domain with the daughter of the current master of this Domain bowing towards him!
The scene around them was unique as the immense heat of the Apollyon Dimension could still be felt while tendrils of magma pillars of flames rose up the endless skies.

What was unique was the vast stretches of land holding twinkling lights of civilization- of a massive empire that had countless structures emitting wondrous light stretching as far as the eyes could see!
The further in one's eyes went, the taller the structures became as one could see they were built from powerful minerals that shone with an incandescent gold-black glow.

The entire area was wider than many Realities put together as some areas included stretches of mountains and forests as wide as Cosmos- these acting as borders that defined different clusters of smaller domains in the larger Rosebud Domain.
In the central domain with the tallest structures...there was a shocking phenomenon above it as in the skies, the massive Skeleton of what seemed to be Daemon Dragon floated powerfully!
Its body gave off fantastical waves of power as its skeletal jaws were opened wide, releasing a drizzling of essence onto the core of the Rosebud Domain where the Golden Succubi dominated.
"That's the preserved body of a Prime Apollyon Dragon Daemon Bloodline that had reached the upper bounds of the Grotto Haven. It has been showing its vital essence for the last 10 million years."
Hecate spoke calmly as their figures were teleporting across the skies and getting ever closer to the central area of the Rosebud Domain that was filled with life.
Today in particular, there was an extra bustling of activity as a somewhat somber celebration was being held!

A few hours prior, they had watched Princess Hecate Eranelon escorted by Orc Daemons to be taken as a concubine of the powerful Mad Orc Daemon Commander who caused the nearby local Emperors to hesitate.

This meant they were effectively allied with this terrifying force as they wouldn't be embroiled in war and destruction until they submitted to the reign of the Mad Orc Daemon Commander who loved brutality and chaos.
So for the vast majority of LEGENDS, this was a cause for celebration.

The reality-sized core of the Rosebud Domain was bustling and active as Golden Succubi and Incubi Daemons moved along with a few minor races, with the Golden Lust City where the ruling Succubi lived being the most bustling as the Ruler of this Domain was present in the celebration here!

There was an expansive feast as those who could be considered Succubi Nobles enjoyed themselves on top of circular golden platforms that stably floated in the skies- thousands of these disk-like platforms holding those in the Firmaments of Ascendancy and LEGENDS rankings from Primogenial to Alpha Strata.
The weakest being celebrated in the buildings below as the largest circular golden platform that took the highest peak was the one where the current Ruler of the Rosebud Domain was situated.
Powerful Alpha and Beta Strata LEGENDS surrounded him as with a drink in hand, his devilish handsomeness showed a tinge of sadness hidden in his kingly visage every time he drank!

He didn't know that two particularly unique beings were crossing the crimson skies of this domain as their target was the very highest golden platform that held the most powerful Succubi and Incubi Daemons.
"Master, are you sure about going straight in like this? My father may be a weak Ultima Strata Incubus, but he is still of the Ultima Strata. Has Master...already reached this stage as well?"
Hecate's voluptuous figure shone with increased beauty and valor as she asked, the reply that came being a unique one!
"No, I haven't personally reached this stage yet."
With a mesmerizing and mysterious smile, Noah spoke out such cryptic words as Hecate's mind and chest buzzed.
'Personally?'

The wording of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor left much to be implied as seeing his worry-free expression, Hecate Eranelon trusted her Master unquestionably as the Daemon of Tyranny delved into the first Domain within the Apollyon Dimension!

"That's the preserved body of a Prime Apollyon Dragon Daemon Bloodline that had reached the upper bounds of the Grotto Haven.
It has been showing its vital essence for the last 10 million years."
Hecate spoke calmly as their figures were teleporting across the skies and getting ever closer to the central area of the Rosebud Domain that was filled with life.
Today in particular, there was an extra bustling of activity as a somewhat somber celebration was being held!

A few hours prior, they had watched Princess Hecate Eranelon escorted by Orc Daemons to be taken as a concubine of the powerful Mad Orc Daemon Commander who caused the nearby local Emperors to hesitate.

This meant they were effectively allied with this terrifying force as they wouldn't be embroiled in war and destruction until they submitted to the reign of the Mad Orc Daemon Commander who loved brutality and chaos.
So for the vast majority of LEGENDS, this was a cause for celebration.

The reality-sized core of the Rosebud Domain was bustling and active as Golden Succubi and Incubi Daemons moved along with a few minor races, with the Golden Lust City where the ruling Succubi lived being the most bustling as the Ruler of this Domain was present in the celebration here!

There was an expansive feast as those who could be considered Succubi Nobles enjoyed themselves on top of circular golden platforms that stably floated in the skies- thousands of these disk-like platforms holding those in the Firmaments of Ascendancy and LEGENDS rankings from Primogenial to Alpha Strata.
The weakest being celebrated in the buildings below as the largest circular golden platform that took the highest peak was the one where the current Ruler of the Rosebud Domain was situated.
Powerful Alpha and Beta Strata LEGENDS surrounded him as with a drink in hand, his devilish handsomeness showed a tinge of sadness hidden in his kingly visage every time he drank!

He didn't know that two particularly unique beings were crossing the crimson skies of this domain as their target was the very highest golden platform that held the most powerful Succubi and Incubi Daemons.
"Master, are you sure about going straight in like this?
My father may be a weak Ultima Strata Incubus, but he is still of the Ultima Strata.
Has Master...already reached this stage as well?"
Hecate's voluptuous figure shone with increased beauty and valor as she asked, the reply that came being a unique one!
"No, I haven't personally reached this stage yet."
With a mesmerizing and mysterious smile, Noah spoke out such cryptic words as Hecate's mind and chest buzzed.
'Personally?'

The wording of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor left much to be implied as seeing his worry-free expression, Hecate Eranelon trusted her Master unquestionably as the Daemon of Tyranny delved into the first Domain within the Apollyon Dimension!

chapters.title: Chapter 1935
paragraphs: A vibrant domain with countless existences.
Hellish pillars of Magma like flames rose up to the skies as they were incorporated as markers, with multiple clusters of densely packed domains shining with activity throughout!
This was the Rosebud Domain of the Incubus Emperor Eranelon- one of the weaker Domains in this region as it was filled with vitality.

Golden disk-like platforms littered the skies that had a giant Daemon Dragon Skeleton floating above, the highest golden platform in the center of this domain holding the core powerhouses that contained even the Incubus Emperor himself!

Seated on a light red throne, this Ultima Strata existence had a solidified crown that valiantly read the words EMPEROR. This was an existence that had broken their shackles before the Age of Quintessence was fully underway as his authority didn't match his power.

He looked aged and powerful as his face contained an evil handsomeness, twisting horns rising from his head as wings with picking light flames burning around them stretched out from behind him as he was adorned in a silky layer of armaments.
The Golden platform he was at the center of was bustling with activity as he drank the golden cup within his hands and showed traces of sadness which would be drowned out and faded away soon after!

He was thinking about 1 particular figure at this time that he had carried back into this domain with his very own hands- after he had begged the Dimensional Royalty he had been with not to discard his daughter just because her mixed blood would be looked down upon in her Prime Apollyon Daemon Royal Lineage.
"Hecate?!"
He seemed to have been thinking of her so much that he heard her name being called out, a wry smile rising from him as he gazed up to see the vibrant figures of Succubi and Incubi come to a stop.
"My goodness...it really is Hecate!"

The same voice that had come out before rang out again as all Wills were roused, their eyes coming to focus on figures that were descending from the skies as among them was none other than Princess Hecate Eranelon!
Was....was she not supposed to be serving the Mad Orc Daemon Commander Stephon by now?

Puzzlement and doubt were prevalent on the faces of exquisite Beta and Alpha Strata Succubi and Incubi as their eyes couldn't help but also focus on the devilish Daemon descending with Hecate and his glorious form- and the realization that Hecate had somehow reached...the Alpha Strata!
"Hecate..."
Eranelon's gaze was difficult to see as he came out of his stupor and sighed at the sight of his daughter.
"Father."
The reply from Hecate was cold as there was no hint of warmth in her words even as she called out her father's title.
Her eyes also carried a hint of sadness and disappointment as she didn't hate many things in this Dimension...but she utterly detested those who were too weak to protect what they love!

For her own father to pawn her off in order to keep his domain and prevent a possible war that would decimate Trillions...even if his excuse was doing it for the safety of the domain- it was still inexcusable.
So even though she saw a hint of sadness in his eyes...it didn't reach her even one bit.
Seeing the coldness from his daughter, many thoughts surged out in the Incubus Emperor's mind and the minds of many of why Princess Hecate Eranelon would be here!
His eyes also turned to the being beside her as he asked the both of them, his gaze retaining the majesty of a king.

"What is this? You were supposed to be on your way to the Domains of the Mad Orc Daemon Commander as if any problems arise, he will use it as a reason to attack! Where is the Legion of Orc Daemons that were escorting you?"

The might of a king was pervasive as all other voices quieted down in this region, their eyes on the figures of Hecate and the devilishly handsome Daemon that even caused the season Succubi to lick their lips!
"They have all perished, father."
Hecate's answer caused alarm to rise in the eyes of many as Eranelon's eyes turned sharp.
"What happened? What could eradicate such a powerful Legion and still have you stand before us-"
"I killed them."
BZZT!
A laid-back voice actually interrupted the Incubus Emperor as the surroundings became oppressive an instant after!
"...What?"
Space crackled and malformed as a terrifying pressure cascaded from Eranelon- the pure grandeur of an Ultima Strata existence beginning to permeate outwards.

All focus came onto the being beside Hecate as his devilish figure took the spotlight, his expansive golden black flaming wings and muscular visage looking extremely laid back as he actually adopted an annoyed expression soon after!
"I don't like repeating myself twice."
WAA!

An air of freedom and tyranny emanated from him as even while standing before the undeniable might of an Ultima Strata existence who could dish out 100+ Billion Damage Values with their full power...he seemed unfettered!

His words were in direct opposition to the grandeur of the Incubus Emperor Eranelon as dozens of nearby Alpha Strata Incubi and Succubi instantly rose into neat and oppressive lines before Noah while Emperor Eranelon himself expanded his authority, the skies becoming infused with a pink light as the Throne he sat on trembled.
Destiny flashed in his eyes as he spoke dangerously.

"You dare to ruin the relations with the Mad Orc Daemon Commander and I while insulting my authority in my own Domain? Who are you? What do you seek?!" Astonishing pink flames were beginning to surge around him as he continued! "My dear daughter, who is this being you bring into our domain and stand beside?!"
The regal wrath of the Incubus Emperor was palpable as lines of Alpha Strata LEGENDS continued to form before him in a fantastical fashion.
Yet even while facing all of this, the expression on Noah's face remained unimpressed as he spoke while his eyes turned sharp.
"I protected your daughter when you failed at such a job, and then I thought of coming here and taking over your domain."
Eyes blinked multiple times as all nearby beings processed the casual words they just heard.
It...was just too straightforward and simple!

chapters.title: Chapter 1936
paragraphs: The Daemon of Tyranny didn't beat around the bush or use any schemes, simply stating that he planned to conquer this domain without any pretenses!
BOOOM!

Wild waves of essence erupted as rows of Alpha Strata LEGENDS instantly called out their Halos and fused with them, their powerful wills surging towards the being casually saying unbelievable and dangerous words!

All those in the surroundings were Commanders of the Incubus Emperor's Legions as they were seasoned fighters, instantly moving in formation as their Legions that were spread out across the Rosebud Domain were also alerted.
The Princess had returned with a foreign being who had eradicated a Legion of the Mad Orc Daemon Commander as he now casually spoke about usurping the reign of the Incubus Emperor!

This was a situation that had to be handled delicately as when the Alpha Strata Commanders attained their strongest forms, Princess Hecate Eranelon shockingly moved in front of the being protectively as if she didn't care for her life.

The wrath in the eyes of the Incubus Emperor was palpable at such a juncture as he raised his hand to command the rows of Alpha Strata LEGENDS. There was a problem on their side as they knew nothing about their enemy, and he didn't make his Realm visible as when they checked him they couldn't be sure what level of power he was!
For him to talk like this, would he have the power to back it or was he merely bluffing?
The answer to this lay with destiny as in order for the Incubus Emperor Eranelon to read this accurately...the wonder that was the Heart of Destiny would have to be absent.
"You don't need to play the guessing game on whether I am powerful and can back up what I said or not."
WAA!

The mesmerizing voice of the Daemon of Tyranny surged as his eyes were not even on the Incubus Emperor, his gaze focused on the rising prompts and changes as the Dimensional Bloodlines he had gained continued to be assimilated along with the Mythical Natural Born Apollyon Physique being incorporated into his Infinite Dream Physique.
<You have gained a preliminary understanding in the Decretum of Apollyon.>

As a Royal Bloodline was assimilated by him while an even more pristine physique was swallowed, the gains continued to come as he waved his hands at this moment to control the pervasive Apollyon Essence that was in the surroundings.
HUUM!

It gradually formed into a Throne of the Decretum of Apollyon behind him as he went to sit down while beckoning for Hecate to come sit on the wide hand rest of the Throne, his voice continuing to echo out in this tense situation!
"You see, you've got a nice domain here with Trillions of beings."
Noah's hand motioned to the vibrant lit up domains below that stretched out endlessly as his smile became even more devilish.
"It would be a shame if it was all razed down by the Mad Orc Daemon Commander because you couldn't protect it, so I'll just be doing it on your behalf."

"Our lives are made up of choices, and two of them lie before you now. You can choose to doubt me and send out an attack to test me, or you can take my words as true and inevitable and you can submit yourselves to me."
He sat on the throne of crimson black essence as his grandeur shockingly surpassed the Incubus Emperor whose face was becoming dark and clouded.
"I will allow you to retain a ruling position if you submit yourself, but if you choose to even test me...I cannot guarantee your life even if you submit after that."
Tyranny.
Boundless and hellish tyranny emanated from this being as he spoke so confidently while facing an Ultima Strata existence!
The weaving of destiny lulled as all Succubi and Incubi in the surroundings got into formation while waiting for the command of their Emperor.
Dozens of Alpha Strata LEGENDS in neat rows were ready as they had taken their true forms while waiting for the command from a single existence!
An existence that had lived for Millions of years and fought off the advancement of other regional lords this whole time!
An existence that had even sacrificed his daughter in order to not have a catastrophic war with a powerful existence that was nearly stepping into the Grotto Haven Realm.
Would he really bend the knee from the words of a single being?
"Father."

Hecate Eranelon seemed to know this as her eyes shone with ingenuity and seriousness. At the end of the day, the man before her was still her father. Since she completely trusted her Master, she knew his words carried immense gravity as if she could, she wished to save him and those of her Lineage.
"If there was ever a time for you to listen to me, it would be now."
"Bend the knee. The one I now serve will lead us towards boundless glory."
An oppressive silence hung in the surroundings as oppressive wills bubbled up even further.
What had to be said was already said.
What remained now was a choice.
Like always...after beings discerned Destiny, there came time for them to make a choice as this would ultimately decide their path.
'But...the choice was made long ago.'
HUUUM!
Noah's thoughts were vibrant as he knew the choice for the Emperor before him was made the moment he made his will known.
It was why he spoke the way he did as ultimately, it served Noah better if he was attacked!
It served him better as it would open up paths of even more loot.
After millions of years of hard work and elevating his Domain to where it was now...would the Incubus Emperor Eranelon really leave it all at the threat of words and even kneel to another being?
BZZZT!
The pink flames rising in the surroundings became even more oppressive as the eyes of the Incubi and Succubi Daemons flashed with power and oppression.
The choice was made.
ZIING!
The rows of Dozens of Alpha Strata LEGENDS moved as tens of Billions of Damage Values in the form of abilities erupted out!
This wasn't all as from his throne, the Incubus Emperor Eranelon also made a move as he didn't just command his Commanders to do so!

Incandescent REIFIED concepts formed in the now pink flaming skies as seated on a newly erected throne made from the Essence of the Decretum of Apollyon, the smile on the Daemon of Tyranny became increasingly deep!

chapters.title: Chapter 1937
paragraphs: The scorching skies above the Rosebud Domain lit up and changed colors, attaining a pinkish hue as the flames of many Succubi and Incubi Daemons rose.
They coagulated into forms of a myriad of Daemons and variations of themselves as they echoed out with boundless destruction- many of them carrying the Essence of the Decretum of Apollyon!
But this wasn't the most dreadful sight.

The most dreadful thing to see was that above the visage of the Incubus Emperor Eranelon, a pair of incandescent illusory wings with countless pairs of pink eyes manifested. And when these eyes opened, they shot out radiant beams of light that formed into a singular dreadful pillar of light that would reach the target far faster than anyone else!
Attacks from dozens of Alpha Strata LEGENDS and an Ultima Strata existence!
They all surged towards the figure of the Daemon of Tyranny as he sat on his makeshift throne, the gaze of this being in the face of this actually remaining calm and pristine as he didn't seem fazed.
Seeing her Master's expression as terrifying attacks surged towards them, Hecate also didn't move a single muscle as she completely trusted him.
As terrifying waves of essence surged towards him like an endless sea that would swallow everything, Noah did nothing but watch as in the next instant...!
SHAAA!
A golden wave flashed before him.
The surging seas of attacks...shockingly faded when they came across this golden wave of light as if they were nothing but a dream.

The only one that vibrated and buzzed when it came in contact with the golden dreamy light was the attack from the Incubus Emperor Eranelon as even this flickered and out of existence before it soon disappeared!
The Daemon of Tyranny had seemingly still yet to make a move!
The atmosphere became utterly oppressive and silent as this laid-back being now spoke.
"If you had simply commanded your Alpha Strata Commanders to move as a test, I would have spared you and demoted you from your position due to your daughter."
"But for attacking me yourself and aiming for my life...that is worthy of death."
RUUMBLE!
The scorching skies trembled as a sandy good light began to drizzle from above.

The wills of many beings quickly rose up in shock as above them all, they noticed a point of golden light had appeared as waves of golden sandy light emanated from it- this light soon coming to cover everything as it was filled with the potent essence of a Decretum of Dreams!
A domain!
Before anyone noticed, a domain was laid down through the authority of a Decretum of another dimension as it enveloped everyone in this area in less than a microsecond.
And the source of this all caused the souls of those that gazed at it to shudder at its emotionless gaze.
Glorious in stature and bright in grandeur and color, it was a dazzling Dream Automaton.

Expansive golden wings stretched out behind its back as its sharp golden arms that seemed like blades shone with a menacing light. Dazzling ecritures of DREAM swirled around it as wondrously, there was also an obsidian glow of authority that surrounded him like a bubble!
An obsidian bubble that seemed to constantly be moving as it was actually the rapid rotation of Ascendancy Halos!
The number of Halos was high as this was the first surprise Noah was shown when the Dream Automaton was raised to the stage of Ultima.
Its Aspects of Existence could enact and control 150 Ascendancy Halos.

And at this stage, it could link and have a stupendous connection with its Halos to attain something at the same level as Noah's Ascendant True Form- with its usage being unique as it linked with its Halos while they spun rapidly enough until it didn't seem like they were single Obsidian rings spinning around it....but a single constantly spinning Obsidian circle that threatened to erase anything that came near!
The emotionless eyes of this automaton shone as after laying down a shocking domain, its sharp Blade like limbs swung down methodically.
<Dream Reality Splitter>.
SHIING!

The erected domain of Dream essence trembled as in the next instant, it seemed like the skies had been sliced in two as this occurred directly before the front line of over a Dozen Alpha Strata LEGENDS.

Whether it was Dream or reality didn't matter as the life force that was holding together these Alpha Strata Succubi and Incubi Daemons began to flicker away as none of them could withstand damage totaling above 100 Billion!

It was a dreadful nightmare to be experiencing as this enemy seemingly came out of nowhere, and it didn't give any moment for its enemies to understand as after seemingly splitting the skies in half, it disappeared.
And then an instant later...
HOONG!

Its massive figure appeared above the Throne of the grim Incubus Emperor Eranelon whose whole body was currently burning with astounding pink flames as he bellowed out his millions of years of knowledge and foundation while pulling on the Decretum of Apollyon around them!

But the right blade-like hand of the Dream Automaton shone as the image of a variation of an Assassin Emperor of Severance formed to its right, while its left bladelike hand also shone as a variation of the Saintess of Fiery Damnation appeared on its left!
No fluctuations or usage of essence could be felt as to cast them, no resources were required.
This...was another surprise once the Dream Automaton reached the Ultima Strata.
Each of its different body parts gained an effect of an EMPYRAL appendage as if it had bathed them and refined them for millions of years.

Noah's abilities were branded into its different limbs as this Dream Automaton held many surprises, with another surprise being its own specialized abilities and skills similar to <Dream Reality Splitter>.
It was a terrifying existence to command as its reserves were directly pulled from the Infinite Reality- this being an extension of one of its features!
And now, it descended onto a local Ultima Strata Ruler of a domain in the Apollyon Dimension who was known to be average.
Could such a being withstand the terrifying power raining down when even the domain in the surroundings was being covered by the sandy essence of Dreams?!

sentences.text: The scorching skies above the Rosebud Domain lit up and changed colors, attaining a pinkish hue as the flames of many Succubi and Incubi Daemons rose.
They coagulated into forms of a myriad of Daemons and variations of themselves as they echoed out with boundless destruction- many of them carrying the Essence of the Decretum of Apollyon!
But this wasn't the most dreadful sight.
The most dreadful thing to see was that above the visage of the Incubus Emperor Eranelon, a pair of incandescent illusory wings with countless pairs of pink eyes manifested.
And when these eyes opened, they shot out radiant beams of light that formed into a singular dreadful pillar of light that would reach the target far faster than anyone else!
Attacks from dozens of Alpha Strata LEGENDS and an Ultima Strata existence!
They all surged towards the figure of the Daemon of Tyranny as he sat on his makeshift throne, the gaze of this being in the face of this actually remaining calm and pristine as he didn't seem fazed.
Seeing her Master's expression as terrifying attacks surged towards them, Hecate also didn't move a single muscle as she completely trusted him.
As terrifying waves of essence surged towards him like an endless sea that would swallow everything, Noah did nothing but watch as in the next instant...!
SHAAA!
A golden wave flashed before him.
The surging seas of attacks...shockingly faded when they came across this golden wave of light as if they were nothing but a dream.

The only one that vibrated and buzzed when it came in contact with the golden dreamy light was the attack from the Incubus Emperor Eranelon as even this flickered and out of existence before it soon disappeared!
The Daemon of Tyranny had seemingly still yet to make a move!
The atmosphere became utterly oppressive and silent as this laid-back being now spoke.
"If you had simply commanded your Alpha Strata Commanders to move as a test, I would have spared you and demoted you from your position due to your daughter."
"But for attacking me yourself and aiming for my life...that is worthy of death."
RUUMBLE!
The scorching skies trembled as a sandy good light began to drizzle from above.

The wills of many beings quickly rose up in shock as above them all, they noticed a point of golden light had appeared as waves of golden sandy light emanated from it- this light soon coming to cover everything as it was filled with the potent essence of a Decretum of Dreams!
A domain!
Before anyone noticed, a domain was laid down through the authority of a Decretum of another dimension as it enveloped everyone in this area in less than a microsecond.
And the source of this all caused the souls of those that gazed at it to shudder at its emotionless gaze.
Glorious in stature and bright in grandeur and color, it was a dazzling Dream Automaton.
Expansive golden wings stretched out behind its back as its sharp golden arms that seemed like blades shone with a menacing light.
Dazzling ecritures of DREAM swirled around it as wondrously, there was also an obsidian glow of authority that surrounded him like a bubble!
An obsidian bubble that seemed to constantly be moving as it was actually the rapid rotation of Ascendancy Halos!
The number of Halos was high as this was the first surprise Noah was shown when the Dream Automaton was raised to the stage of Ultima.
Its Aspects of Existence could enact and control 150 Ascendancy Halos.

And at this stage, it could link and have a stupendous connection with its Halos to attain something at the same level as Noah's Ascendant True Form- with its usage being unique as it linked with its Halos while they spun rapidly enough until it didn't seem like they were single Obsidian rings spinning around it....but a single constantly spinning Obsidian circle that threatened to erase anything that came near!
The emotionless eyes of this automaton shone as after laying down a shocking domain, its sharp Blade like limbs swung down methodically.
<Dream Reality Splitter>.
SHIING!

The erected domain of Dream essence trembled as in the next instant, it seemed like the skies had been sliced in two as this occurred directly before the front line of over a Dozen Alpha Strata LEGENDS.

Whether it was Dream or reality didn't matter as the life force that was holding together these Alpha Strata Succubi and Incubi Daemons began to flicker away as none of them could withstand damage totaling above 100 Billion!

It was a dreadful nightmare to be experiencing as this enemy seemingly came out of nowhere, and it didn't give any moment for its enemies to understand as after seemingly splitting the skies in half, it disappeared.
And then an instant later...
HOONG!

Its massive figure appeared above the Throne of the grim Incubus Emperor Eranelon whose whole body was currently burning with astounding pink flames as he bellowed out his millions of years of knowledge and foundation while pulling on the Decretum of Apollyon around them!

But the right blade-like hand of the Dream Automaton shone as the image of a variation of an Assassin Emperor of Severance formed to its right, while its left bladelike hand also shone as a variation of the Saintess of Fiery Damnation appeared on its left!
No fluctuations or usage of essence could be felt as to cast them, no resources were required.
This...was another surprise once the Dream Automaton reached the Ultima Strata.
Each of its different body parts gained an effect of an EMPYRAL appendage as if it had bathed them and refined them for millions of years.

Noah's abilities were branded into its different limbs as this Dream Automaton held many surprises, with another surprise being its own specialized abilities and skills similar to <Dream Reality Splitter>.
It was a terrifying existence to command as its reserves were directly pulled from the Infinite Reality- this being an extension of one of its features!
And now, it descended onto a local Ultima Strata Ruler of a domain in the Apollyon Dimension who was known to be average.
Could such a being withstand the terrifying power raining down when even the domain in the surroundings was being covered by the sandy essence of Dreams?!

chapters.title: Chapter 1938
paragraphs: Towards the unfolding battle between two Ultima Strata LEGENDs, the answer was crystal clear as in the distance, Hecate could see it clearly as her eyes flashed with a profound light.

She turned away from the unfolding fight that showed Succubi and Incubi Daemons scrambling in shock and stupor, her visage coming off of the Throne of Apollyon Essence as her crimson wings tucked behind her- her body falling onto the lap of the calm Daemon of Tyranny that was watching the unfolding scenes coldly.
She placed her head on his chest as his Gravitational Reality Armament didn't push her away, her eyes closing as she spoke sonorously!

"You do not need to spare him for my sake, Master. He abandoned me to be toyed with by a Mad Orc Daemon as why should I hold the same kindness? I've already done my duty by trying to dissuade him and he didn't listen."
Her closed eyes were surging with boundless light underneath as she could feel her heart go through many changes while she spoke!

"Continue to display your hellish tyranny. Let all the Succubi and Incubi Daemons know and see your capability for destruction as at the end, you can establish the beginning of your reign here with the death of the Ruler of this Domain."
Her voice was low as she spoke, Noah taking her head from his chest and raising her to look at him as her sultry crimson eyes opened slowly.

She told him before that all she sought was to establish her own source of strength to rely on. As she continued to prove herself and her unique thought process, Noah appreciated her even more as while a shocking battle unfolded, he stroked her crimson black hair as if to console her!

It was a ridiculous scene to look at as essentially, a daughter was telling her new man that he could eradicate her father after he didn't heed her many warnings, and that her father's death would simply act as the springboard for this new Master she served to elevate himself even further.
The ideology of other beings might never be able to grasp the intricacies and morality of this as it may even feel disconcerting to observe!

And as surging pillars of pink flames rose around the body of the Incubus Emperor Eranelon, his will was able to see his precious daughter in the lap of a terrifying Emperor as she wasn't even gazing in his direction while he fought for his very life.
"OOOOOOH!"

An unbelievable mixture of emotions surged as this being fought against the Daemon of Tyranny who would make his Conquest in the first Dimensional Domain soon, even more powerful nearby Rulers catching wind of this soon enough as a cataclysmic shift was slowly budding in a small area in the lands of the Dimensional Hellion Ruler- the Hellish Pontiff Lucius!
In the Dream Dimension.

The strings of prompts from Noah's achievements in the Apollyon Dimension crossed through the mind of the Dream Dimensional Body as the glorious allure of Grotto Panaceas began to flow in once more as Alpha Strata Incubi and Succubi Daemons fell.

His body in the Apollyon Dimension was doing well as Noah patiently waited for the inevitable discovery of the Absolute Kainos Dream Dungeon, and he wasn't given the privilege of waiting too long as the eyes of the Dream Dimensional Chassis opened up with a sharp light at this moment!
Outside of the Absolute Kainos Dream Dungeon.
"What contraption is this? It continues to expand its domain while seemingly swallowing up the surrounding lands..."
A grating metallic voice echoed out as the image of a massive grotesque floating head was its source.
The head had many pairs of white eyes as lacerations ran across its surface that shone with a golden dreamy light, the rest of its body shrouded by a black-gold color as this was a Nightmare!
Beside it, the humanoid form of another Nightmare could be seen as half of its body had skin and Musculature as the other half had a black Skeleton that blazed with golden flames.
The face of this particular Nightmare was grim as it spoke slowly.

"It is more than that...you might not be in tune because you're such a dumb oaf, but the reason we discovered it wasn't just that it was expanding in size for us to see it- but the distance between this contraption and our domains...has also gotten shorter."
WAA!

They were gazing at a massive golden monolith in the distance that pointed its peak to the Golden skies, an air of mystery and authority behind it as in its immediate periphery, the surrounding lands could all be seen surging towards it!
"It...is genuinely swallowing not just the surface layer of Dream Domains...but everything around it for it to be able to cause the constriction of land!"
A semblance of the terrifying truth was seen by the two Nightmares who blazed with auras at the Alpha Strata, a few hundred more Nightmares behind them as they awaited their orders on how to move.
"We must go in to see what it is."
The Humanoid Nightmare spoke seriously as the Head Nightmare asked doubtfully.
"We could send word to the detestable Dream LEGENDS nearby or those who have Grotto Haven powerhouses within them, this seems serious."
The weaving of destiny flowed serenely.
A time of choices descended once again!

The Humanoid Nightmare contemplated before sending a transmission behind him, alerting a party of 10 Nightmares to head out to alert the major forces in somewhat deeper regions of the Dream Dimension while...
"We'll send word and enter at the same time. After all, this could also be a tremendous opportunity if we got our hands on a contraption that can absorb the very Dream Essence we stand atop of!"

Careful confidence could be felt as the two Nightmares came to an agreement, moving forward with a small Legion behind them as they entered the periphery of the Quintessential Absolute Kainos Dream Dungeon.
A Dungeon that the moment they entered...
<Welcome to the Quintessential Absolute Kainos Dream Dungeon.>
A brilliant set of golden words flashed before their eyes as their bodies buzzed with their full power, ready to erupt at any time they felt a level of danger.
But shock was coursing through the Two Alpha Nightmares as well as ecstasy as a single thought crossed their minds.
"A Relic of our Age of Quintessence?!"
Their hearts shuddered as they felt like they had stumbled onto something unbelievable and grand, proceeding forward even faster as they had high expectations!
Yet another set of words appeared before them as they shone with the same gorgeous gold.
<Obtain Loot or Become Loot, that is the question.>
A simple pondering or musing.
And something that all those who stepped into the Absolute Kainos Dream Dungeon would face!

chapters.title: Chapter 1939
paragraphs: <Obtain Loot or Become Loot, that is the question.>
A Prompt that would rise for anyone entering the Domain of the Quintessential Absolute Kainos Dream Dungeon!
In the case of the Nightmares, their eyes only became emboldened as they flew towards the entrance of the enormous golden monolith that pointed to the hazy gold skies, but...
"Huh?"

Their senses grasped onto an anomaly as in the middle of the gateway leading onto the first floor of the Dungeon, the REIFIED form of a curvaceous woman wrapped in a fiery gold robe could be seen as her eyes shone like the sun.

With an expression of excitement, she beckoned towards the 2 Alpha Strata Nightmares and the small Legion of Beta Strata Nightmares behind them nuclear balls of flames already began to bloom at her fingertips!

The Saintess of Fiery Damnation greeted the first entrants of the Quintessential Absolute Kainos Dream Dungeon as the Dungeon Boss of this domain was just too unfair, releasing an attack before the enemies that had dived in could even fully step onto the first floor!
Outside of the Absolute Kainos Dream Dungeon Monolith.

The small party of Beta Strata Nightmares that were given the command to bring information back about what they saw to a nearby cluster of powerful Nightmares and Dream LEGENDS were nearly out of the periphery and about to disappear into the sandy waves of golden essence when...
SHAA!

An existence wielding a sickle and moving like a beam of light instantly surged and linked between each of their bodies, severing their Aspects of Existence before they could even know what was happening as their massive grotesque bodies slumped down soon after!

A moment later, the figure of one of Noah's Clones appeared as he looked at the bodies of these Nightmares, this Clone beginning to change as he morphed into one of these Nightmares who had a Humanoid visage but a head that had no eyes and seemed forged from crystals.

Perfectly mimicking this Nightmare, Noah delved into its memories and the memories of others as nearby Domains of the periphery of the Dream Dimension were painted in his mind, his eyes shining with ingenuity as he moved!

He could have allowed this party of Nightmare LEGENDS to get the word out as they were told as this would bring more existences for Noah to attain Loot from, or even could kill them and stop them entirely.
Noah chose a different route as he eradicated them and took their place...in order to control the information that would spread out in this region.

The actions he was taking of swallowing the lands of a Dimension were grand as he knew sooner or later...those with the power of Dimensional Hellion Rulers- beings who could influence Absolute Dream Authority...even they would step into the Absolute Kainos Dream Dungeon!

This was something he couldn't control, but he could control the pace of the information and who received it for as long as he could- keeping a steady stream of enemies he could handle before the truly maddening existences entered the fray.
In the form of a Nightmare, he moved to pull on the strings of powerful domains while the Absolute Kainos Dream Dungeon swallowed the first Hunters that stepped foot into it!
The 9 Dimensions were known as the Anchors that held down the Barren Lands, or more commonly known- the Desolate Mausoleum that referred to the Infinite Realities!
For them to be Anchors, they naturally had a job.
For a job to be carried out, a Will had to be present.
Whether something connected to the Dimension itself...or an existence placed in that position to keep it that way!
At this moment in time, in the innermost depths of the Dream Dimension.

The Decretum of Dreams was thick in the surroundings as hues of sandy gold covered everything, with wisps of Absolute Dream Authority surging in the surroundings as a figure was masked within this terrifying cluster of essences!
His figure was utterly massive as very little could be seen of him within the surging essences, the only thing that flashed every now and then being the allure of an uncountable number of Realities.
It signified his status as an existence that at the lowest was at the Grotto Haven Realm as he could very well be leagues above this.
Yet at this moment, the luminous eyes of this being opened as they shone like golden suns, these eyes locking onto the surroundings as if they were reading the Essence moving around him!
And...it was truly so as streams of Absolute Dream Authority surged out from above and sunk into his visage.
Thereafter...an ancient voice arose as it very clearly distinguished itself to have the vicissitude of a being that had lived across multiple Ages.
"Something is...."

This ancient voice was seemingly getting information from the Absolute Dream Authority flowing into him as he seemed to actually be having a difficulty interpreting them, but it wasn't due to power as there were many other factors in play.
After some time, this being was able to decipher and understand the full message.
"Something is encroaching upon the authority of the Dimension?!"
WAA!
Such a shocking message flowed down as the surging essences in the surroundings turned chaotic.
Yet it wasn't done as one more stream of the Essence of Absolute Dream Authority sank into his unseen visage.
It took an even longer time for this to be deciphered but in time, this existence was able to get it as his luminous eyes released Seas of blinding golden light.
"Dimensional Inimicus...it is the Dimensional Inimicus!"
A burst of shock and anger rose in the eyes of this massive being as these two words floated in his mind!
Dimensional Inimicus!
The word Inimicus has a relation to hostility or enemy.
Quite frankly, it was another way of saying Enemy of the Dimension.
Something had been termed the Enemy of a Dimension as such a thing stood directly opposite to the aims of a Dimension- aims that Dimensional Rulers had to make sure were flowing smoothly!
And one such being had received such information as even then...this was all he got.
Where was this enemy?
What exactly were they doing?
None of this information flowed into him!
This was because it was much harder for the role of the Dimensions to be carried out as communicating with them had become nigh impossible after the actions of a certain being!
