chapters.title: Chapter 1950
paragraphs: As Noah's body lit up with verdant light while a second Dimension was being forged, magisterial prompts and information sunk into his mind.
<Your Infinite Quintessential Dimensional Reality Passages have resonated with the birth of your Second Paramount Kainos Dimensional Reality and are undergoing further evolution.>
<The Decretum of the Dimension you have forged in your Origin will be generated and nourish you amidst all other essences.>
HOOONG!
<Increased Understanding of the Decretum of Prana will slowly be formed as its essence melds with you.>
Any Dimensional Layer he forged, he would no doubt attain the Decretum of this Dimension and even have its percentage raised when he completed important benchmarks.
The abstruse understanding of the Prana Dimension was being formed as at the end of it all...Noah would undoubtedly wield the Decretum of all Dimensions.
But from the many changes brought by the formation of the second Dimensional Layer...
<An Infinite Quintessential Dimensional Reality Passage can now generate 90,000 Units of the Essence of Reality per second.>
<The rate of Refining Empyral Bones, Organs, and Musculature has been greatly elevated.>
Pure wonders bloomed as when Noah established his first Dimension, many changes occurred.

The Infinite Reality Passages had become Infinite Quintessential Dimensional Reality Passages that were elevated once more with the formation of the Second Dimensional Layer, and Noah's Traits had undergone a change back then as when as his Tri-Pupiled eyes being born as the authority of his advancement had taken many aspects of him and upgraded them!
But that was then, and this was now.
A symphony began to play as the surroundings turned glorious.
At this point in time, Noah wanted to be more methodical and gain greater benefits in one extreme.
More surgical and precise!
<The Authority of the birth of the Second Dimensional Layer is being focused on the Trait of Infinite Mana.>
<Greater authority and elevation are being bestowed on the Trait of Infinite Mana.>
WAA!
<The features of Skill Succession, Concept Amalgamation, and Resource Master have been greatly elevated.>
Surges of essence and authority raged within Noah's body as his Tri-Pupiled eyes released beams of radiant light.

He wanted to be more focused in his elevation as he brought out even more power in one extreme, and his main goal for this current venture was the Infinite Mana Trait yes...but more so the Skill Succession feature of it.
<The Will of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor gazes expectantly at the feature of Skill Succession.>

<Skill Succession>:: When casting an ability, a second ability can be linked to it to be cast at the same time as the second ability's resource cost is replaced by pure Mana. This feature has been further enhanced as now, additional abilities can be linked in an exchange for an extremely high cost- a cost that ignores Reality altering effects as it must be paid by you in its entirety. A third ability can be linked to form a chain of three abilities, with the cost of bringing forth to fruition 3 linked abilities being 1 Trillion Mana and 100 Million Units of the Essence of Reality. Bringing to fruition a Skill Succession of 4 Linked abilities costs 5 Trillion Mana and 500 Million Units of the Essence of Reality, and 5 Linked abilities cost 10 Trillion Mana and 1,000 Million Units of the Essence of Reality. The high cost of casting the linked abilities is a testament to their power as once more- their cost must be paid in full as they ignore any and all Reality altering effects, even Resource Cost Nullification...
A description of pure wonder lay before Noah's eyes.
Skill Succession.

He had utilized it last to bring forth Ascendant Severing Soul Star that turned the Assassin Emperor of Severance into a multi-target ability that instantly wiped out millions of LEGENDS no matter if they were Primogenial or Beta Strata.

It wasn't simply one plus one as the linking of abilities brought about unknown changes and heavily increased their Damage...with the linking of a third or fourth ability being something so far-fetched that it might be twice or three times Noah's normal Damage Value with any Skill.

If he could currently unleash 70 Billion True Dimensional Damage Values- a number that had undoubtedly changed as he would be getting another boost to his base Damage value for establishing the Second Dimensional Layer and blow up this Damage even further...but if we utilize this 70 Billion as an example of a normal Damage Value, a single cast of a 3 linked ability brought forth by Skill Succession could possibly deal 140 Billion or 210 Billion...if not even more depending on the resonance of the abilities and what effects they would bring.

When facing against an uber-powerful enemy where the multiple links of Sever could not be achieved against them, Noah being capable of dishing out a single ability that could deal hundreds of Billions of Damage Values would be indispensable!

He could utilize upto three chained abilities at this juncture with the undeniable price of 100 Million Units of the Essence of Reality that would deplete close to a third of all his reserves in a single shot, but the chains of these abilities that formed into different skills and techniques would be his killing blows against obscenely powerful enemies!
He wanted to give a simple quantification for these techniques and those to come as he wanted to group them all under a banner of specific abilities.
A banner of specific techniques meant for killing and annihilation that would be one of a kind in this Age and Era.
HOONG!
His eyes lit up as the ideas swirling in his mind came to fruition, his voice coming out to cement them in stone.
"Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Techniques."
WAA!
Sets of abilities that when linked together and cast, they formed into new Techniques!
Techniques that when the Quintessential Kainos Emperor cast- his enemies could do nothing but face Annihilation.
This was the distinction Noah want to give his optimization of skills as his Second Dimensional Layer was being established.
The Ascendant Severing Soul Star was only the first of these Annihilation Techniques, merely the first form of what was to come!
<Author's Note>

<Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Techniques>:: Techniques brought forth by the Quintessential Kainos Emperor as when cast, his enemies can only face Annihilation. Currently available forms based on the capabilities of Skill Succession: [Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique- First Form], [Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique- Second Form], and [Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique- Third Form].

[Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique- First Form]:: The descent of the Ascendant Severing Soul Star. The Assassin Emperor of Severance becomes a multi-target ability that initiates against all those that gaze at the Star of Illumination, and the amount of times the Assassin Emperor of Severance can chain is limited to once under the multi-target effect.

A description of pure wonder lay before Noah's eyes.
Skill Succession.

He had utilized it last to bring forth Ascendant Severing Soul Star that turned the Assassin Emperor of Severance into a multi-target ability that instantly wiped out millions of LEGENDS no matter if they were Primogenial or Beta Strata.

It wasn't simply one plus one as the linking of abilities brought about unknown changes and heavily increased their Damage...with the linking of a third or fourth ability being something so far-fetched that it might be twice or three times Noah's normal Damage Value with any Skill.

If he could currently unleash 70 Billion True Dimensional Damage Values- a number that had undoubtedly changed as he would be getting another boost to his base Damage value for establishing the Second Dimensional Layer and blow up this Damage even further...but if we utilize this 70 Billion as an example of a normal Damage Value, a single cast of a 3 linked ability brought forth by Skill Succession could possibly deal 140 Billion or 210 Billion...if not even more depending on the resonance of the abilities and what effects they would bring.

When facing against an uber-powerful enemy where the multiple links of Sever could not be achieved against them, Noah being capable of dishing out a single ability that could deal hundreds of Billions of Damage Values would be indispensable!

He could utilize upto three chained abilities at this juncture with the undeniable price of 100 Million Units of the Essence of Reality that would deplete close to a third of all his reserves in a single shot, but the chains of these abilities that formed into different skills and techniques would be his killing blows against obscenely powerful enemies!
He wanted to give a simple quantification for these techniques and those to come as he wanted to group them all under a banner of specific abilities.
A banner of specific techniques meant for killing and annihilation that would be one of a kind in this Age and Era.
HOONG!
His eyes lit up as the ideas swirling in his mind came to fruition, his voice coming out to cement them in stone.
"Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Techniques."
WAA!
Sets of abilities that when linked together and cast, they formed into new Techniques!
Techniques that when the Quintessential Kainos Emperor cast- his enemies could do nothing but face Annihilation.
This was the distinction Noah want to give his optimization of skills as his Second Dimensional Layer was being established.
The Ascendant Severing Soul Star was only the first of these Annihilation Techniques, merely the first form of what was to come!
<Author's Note>
<Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Techniques>:: Techniques brought forth by the Quintessential Kainos Emperor as when cast, his enemies can only face Annihilation.

Currently available forms based on the capabilities of Skill Succession: [Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique- First Form], [Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique- Second Form], and [Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique- Third Form].
[Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique- First Form]:: The descent of the Ascendant Severing Soul Star.

The Assassin Emperor of Severance becomes a multi-target ability that initiates against all those that gaze at the Star of Illumination, and the amount of times the Assassin Emperor of Severance can chain is limited to once under the multi-target effect.

chapters.title: Chapter 1951
paragraphs: As always, Noah made preparations for what was to come.

The Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Techniques would be future trump cards that would have a high cost when he made the 3 linked and 4 linked abilities, but his own power would always be the most crucial.
And ever so steadily, it continued to elevate as after the Enhancement of the Trait of Infinite Mana once more, the remaining boons of the establishment of the Second Dimensional Layer continued.
<The established Paramount Kainos Prana Dimensional Reality grants a base addition of 30,000 Dimensional Dream Damage and Defense Values, bringing your Overall Origin Base Value to 110,000.>
"Oh?"

Noah's Tri-Pupiled eyes shone brightly as the initial establishment of the Dream Dimensional Reality granted a base of 20,000 at its initial stage, 40,000 Halfway, and 80,000 when completed. Yet the initial stage of the Second Dimensional Layer was even higher as it left behind grand expectations for what was to come!
His body was continuing to illuminate with a green glow above the gold as changes continued unabashedly, his heart and blood buzzing as he felt the reserves within him expanded once more as well.
<Your Reserves of the Essence of Reality have been elevated to the Maximum of 175 Million.>
<Your Affinity to the Natural Laws of Reality has risen greatly!>
<Your Affinity to the Decretum of all Dimensions has risen greatly!>
<You can now forge the Quintessential Kainos Prana Dimensional Chassis.>
<Your Maximum Number of Ascendancy Halos is now 180.>
Pure black gold texts in golden prompt boxes continued to astound him and cement his power in the Ultima Strata as yet another Dimensional Body became available for him to grant to one of his Clones.

And since the boons of establishing a Quintessential Dimensional Chassis were grand with their effects benefiting Noah right away, his will surged out with his intention to designate a Clone for this even before the prompts of the boons of the Second Dimensional Layer continued!

As his Origin continued to change and advance, so did his resonated Body and Soul as their breadth greatly expanded, the pathways of Cycles of his Infinite Physique opening up freely as everything about him became even more robust.

<Your Body and Innate Dimensional Barrier are undergoing changes and incorporating the essence of Prana, its defense now equivalent to 400% of the highest reachable Defense Values in your strongest form.>

<Your Dimensional Sea is undergoing changes and incorporating the essence of a second Dimension as your understanding in Decretum of Dimensions becomes even smoother. The process of infusing the Essence of Decretum of Dimensions into concepts and relics to forge the stage of HERESY is even smoother as the rate of infusion is increased by 1,000,000%. Your soul begins the process of Ionization as its resonance with all Aspects of Existence is even more interlinked.>
His body felt nourished.
His soul even more so as it underwent the changes that all geniuses stepping out of the Alpha and into the Ultima Strata went through!
The prompts for the establishment of the Second Dimensional Layer ended.
His Origin buzzed as wondrous stability came in, the unfurling Grotto Panaceas around him releasing a radiant light as they continued to be absorbed by him.

Out of the 25, 18 remained as they would equate to 27 Trillion Kainos Royal Prana Cosmos- requiring Noah to wait until the next influx of this wondrous loot came before he could continue his ridiculous pace of progression.

There was a glorious allure of incandescent light all around him with the Grotto Panaceas alone as above him, 134 radiant Infinite Reality Passages stood like mountains as they shone with a vibrant green and gold stellar Dimensional light- gushing down Dimensional Essence and Essence of Reality among many others as with the evolution of his Infinite Physique that would soon come under a different name as it incorporated more than just the aspects of Dream Essence...the maximum number of Reality Passages were far for being reached with this tool in place.

The number of cycles had already exceeded 45 as a proper quantification of the Infinite Physique was not established yet due to the constant evolutions and enhancements from multiple sources, Noah waiting for it to incorporate everything before coming up with a clear description in time!
But he was proceeding steadily.

As mountains of stellar green-gold dimensional light nourished him from above with his bones nearly reaching the EMPYRAL stage, he appreciated where he reached for s brief second before looking at the many paths he was already going down on.
The Avalon Dimension, the Dream Dimension, the Apollyon Dimension, and the Main Reality.

Each had their own developments and boons as after a few hours, Noah's will focused on the Clone of Alexander King in the Main Reality- the boons here almost as fundamental and as important as the establishment of his Dimensions!
Time passed as many events unfolded and progressed.
In the Main Reality, Noah's Clone of Alexander had his time limit coming up in the Empyral Domain of Nature as before the last hour could wrap up...

"Finish everything within the next few minutes. Changes are unfolding in the outside Realities as Dimensional Races have begun to pour into our Realities, with the Legion you shall join already assembled outside and waiting for you. They cannot wait any longer."
The terrifying powerful Primordial that was keeping watch over the Empyral Domain of Nature spoke out from his unknown location as Noah's eyes opened.
His actions had produced effects as his choices had directly changed the course and Karma of many beings.

Initially, he was bound to be heading to the Niflheim Dimension to reinforce a Dimensional Stronghold from the attacks of Ancient Races and Dimensional Races, yet what he did in that unique space he appeared in caused an instant change in the course of this path as now, it had progressed to the immediate reinforcement of Pure-Blooded Domains as Dream LEGENDS and Nightmares from the Dream Dimension were on a path of destruction!

chapters.title: Chapter 1952
paragraphs: The forces of the Dream Dimension were surging into the vast Realities as long-held restrictions were broken down, their aim being none other than the Dimensional Inimicus that was Noah.

When the time came that the Latent Will of the Dream Dimension figures out his location in the Absolute Kainos Dream Dungeon, Noah could expect the same force being utilized to invade the vast Realities to be directed towards him...if not an even more horrific force coming for him.
He had to be ready.
He had to make sure that the authority of the Absolute Kainos Dream Dungeon would aid him to get past any enemies, even if Dimensional Rulers themselves came!
HUUM!
A buzzing sound whipped around him as the words of the unknown existences guarding the Empyral Domain of Nature rang in his mind.
The Legions had already been assembled as he would be joining them now.
This unique region was a haven for grasping and increasing ones understanding of Natural Laws as when given the chance, nobody would ever want to leave here.
But the surging Essence was limited as what Noah had absorbed in a day was something that others would struggle to absorb in months!

The hidden Primordial with an unknown level of power knew this very well after he spoke to Noah about leaving even earlier than expected, the voice of this being ringing out again as Noah rose to make his exit.

"You are unique and have a bright future as a possible pillar of our Bloodline, so I'll give you the same warning and advice I've given others like you over the years. Don't try to leave a marker or any Relic in this place that you think will allow you to silently come back here to obtain some benefits. Geniuses who violated the rules of the Empyral Domains of Nature have tried and failed as I strip them of their power myself. Don't make the same mistake."

"Bid your time, increase your efforts for our Bloodline and you will be back here before you know it, while also giving others of our Bloodline a chance to experience something similar and keep it going for generations. Only then can we grow stronger collectively. Only then can we live up to the legend of the Great Ruler."
WAA!

The archaic voice of this powerful being echoed out with vibrations of Natural Laws, Noah feeling the buzzing essence around him as without another word, he began to walk out from the raging storms of Natural Law Essences.
If he couldn't escape the eyes of this powerful Primordial today, he would simply plan and make the means to escape from his gaze later on!

This location was too profound to simply visit once and leave after a day under the beckoning of Primordials, and the Quintessential Kainos Emperor would not be held back from enjoying it for too long.
But first, there was the most pressing issue that was coming up.
PA! PA!
Noah's steps were light as he left the area of dense Natural Law Essences, looking at his gains that made him want to be back here as soon as possible.

As he walked, his body was surrounded by surging waves of all types of Essence as he pulled in the essence of Gravitation, Polarity, and Manadynamics the most- his attainments having been astounding to say the least as a few minutes would be enough to quantify everything he had obtained!
First and foremost was the Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics.
The Natural Law that even stood above Gravitation and Polarity.

[Fundamental Natural Law <Manadynamics>:: A ruling authority that governs the absolute workings of Reality. Understanding it to completion means comprehending this aspect of Reality as you can easily influence it in an unimaginable manner. With the understanding of Manadynamics, one can come to the realization that essence can neither be created nor destroyed, simply changed into different forms. This Fundamental Natural Law is closely interlinked with the Fundamental Natural Law of Entropy as initially understanding in this can soon grant you an understanding of Entropy. Manadynamics classifies everything into its own domains and systems, where the total change in the essence of any system will always be equal to the Mana exchanged between the system and its surroundings, and the influence exerted by the systems or on the system by an outside force. The manipulation of Mana and the influence or authority you can exert in any domain or system can be more easily completed with a greater understanding of Manadynamics as when reaching a sufficient level, you will be able to manipulate the Fundamental Natural Law to the extent that all essence will come under your fingertips, with your usage of it being abundant and inexhaustible as the influence you exert can be minimal to produce astonishing results....]

[...The conversion of essence into different forms is better understood by you as there even lies a possibility to convert pure Mana into the very Essence of Reality and ultimately- into any type of essence in existence. You have personally experienced a unique phenomenon and mutation with your soul where the passive, rapid, and constant exchange of all types of essence into Mana has been occurring- all of this Mana being pulled into your body and utilized by you to form abilities and skills that in the end return back to pure Mana that is reclaimed by your surroundings. Due to this, you have gained the unique title of <Infinite Conduit> for successfully and without your knowledge gaining access to a soul that undergoes a constant exchange of energies into different forms, following the principles of Manadynamics. Due to unknowingly delving into the workings of Manadynamics and your continued usage of it, your initial understanding of this Fundamental Natural Law is much greater that workings of this Natural Law can also be infused into concepts or Relics to produce the attainments of Transcendent DHARMA- a stage that can allow DHARMIC essence to be infused into REIFIED abilities and grant them increased autonomy, power, and size. Concepts or tools affected by the Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics will find their exchange of energy altered greatly as other effects will vary. Current understanding of the Natural Law of Manadynamics 5%. Current Boosts granted to abilities infused with the Essence of Manadynamics- 50% Augmentation to All Essence Reserves, Essence Exchange Value, True Damage Values, True Defense Values, and True Vitality Values. The closer you are to fully understanding a Natural Law, the closer you are to the truth...>]
A lengthy description.
And an answer to a grand question!
Had Noah ever violated the Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics?

chapters.title: Chapter 1953
paragraphs: Had Noah ever violated the Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics?
Energy could neither be created nor destroyed, only changed into a different form!
The reserves of essence in one's body were limited.

Unique Entities like stellar bodies, Universes, Cosmos, and Realities fell under their own system as due to their interlinked nature with the very fabric and makeup of reality, they enjoyed immense reserves of essence.
In the beginning, Noah borrowed the very Essence of his Planet as no other being could compare to him in his Mana.
Its essence was transformed into Mana which was then changed by Noah's concepts into different forms of energy- skills and abilities.
In this area, he adhered to the Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics.
He then went to borrow the Essence of his Galaxy and Universe as he still adhered to this Fundamental Natural Law!
Ultimately...his Trait had fully solidified to grant him the reality altering concept of Infinite Mana.
And that was great and all in translation...but where did all that essence come from?
If not from his planet, or Cosmos, it still had to be coming from somewhere as Noah couldn't just create- this would be going against the very fabric of Reality!
The Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics had to be followed.
Energy could neither be created nor destroyed, only changed into a different form.
And this...was the crux of why Noah was granted the title of <Infinite Conduit> after the mutation of his soul so long ago.
A Conduit was something that connected or exchanged something. A Conduit to connect pipes of water or for wiring different forms of energy.

When Noah attained what he considered the full Reality altering Trait of Infinite Mana, he had transcended many concepts and made himself a Conduit that instantaneously exchanged different forms of essence into pure mana- pure Mana that he utilized an infinite amount of as he was not drawing it from himself, but from the outside!
To better understand this, the description of the Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics had to come into the picture.

It stated that "<Manadynamics classifies everything into its own domains and systems, where the total change in the essence of any system will always be equal to the Mana exchanged between the system and its surroundings, and the influence exerted by the system or on the system by an outside force.>"

Everything had its own domain and system. One can imagine it akin to a bubble- where Noah and all the variety of other existences had their own bubbles that surrounded who they were, and that was their domain.
Stellar bodies have their own systems and domains that adhered to the Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics.
The vast Realities had their own systems and domains!
The 9 Dimensions had their own systems and domains!

The Desolate Mausoleum...has its own Domain where its total change of essence was always equal to the Mana exchanged between it and its surroundings, and the influence exerted by it or on it by an outside force!
What Noah had done was something critical where the energy he utilized and transformed did not come from his own system.
His reserves of Mana did not remain enclosed within his own bubble of domain.
The first few times he pierced this bubble was with his Planet and then Galaxy and then Universe as he utilized the Domains and systems of other entities.

This was outside of the boundaries of what existences were supposed to do, but since he still utilized this energy and transformed it into skills and abilities that returned their essence back into the surroundings as the Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics returned everything where it should be...he still had not violated this Fundamental Natural Law!
HUUUM!
As Noah was lost in this epiphany while gazing at the description of this Law, his Main Body pulsed with a unique sensation as Resonance of Nature shone brightly.
His stellar visage with two Dimensional Layers illuminated as his Tri-Pupiled eyes released rays of light.

His sight seemed to be cleared up as while releasing luminous light that made his pupils seem like three blazing suns, he gazed upon the surroundings after gaining an understanding in the Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics.
He saw the vast Dimensional Holy Land and the Seas of multicolored Essence within it...but he saw even more than that.

He saw how these Seas of essence weren't just increasing in density and volume out of nowhere, with immaculate and unseen cracks in space leaking out white streams of essence that transformed into Seas of golden Destiny or verdant life force!
He moved even further to gaze upon his people as his eyes landed on the vibrantly glorious body of Halcyon.

As her golden hair flowed over her shoulders while she trained, Noah could see a massive bubble of golden light around her. It contained robust forms of swirling energies that she breathed in and out constantly without her knowledge, and any time she cast a skill, some of the energy within her golden bubble would be taken and transformed to enact her skill in the outside world!
The skill of a flash of golden lightning was cast as it cracked apart space, but then soon enough, it faded. It faded and turned into streams of unseen essence that assimilated into the surroundings.
And when Noah gazed back at her, the energies within her bubble were reduced. But soon after...her bubble pulsed as energy from the surroundings began to flow into it!
To fill up the Essence that was just used and transformed into something else that returned to the surroundings.
Her own body also pulsed as it attracted this essence even faster, this being her Value of Mana Regeneration that affected this!
WAA!
It was a flow of energy.
Everything was accounted for.
Neither created nor destroyed, only changed into a different form.
<An Astounding Achievement!>
<You are gazing upon the very workings of the Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics as your understanding is further increased by an additional 5%!>
The prompt rained down but Noah wasn't gazing at it.
He gazed at other beings as he saw a slightly larger golden bubble around the Emperor Penguin, a massive bubble around Little Henry, and a smaller bubble around the Shadow Guard Night.
After he gazed at his surroundings and others, he came to himself.
His eyes turned to himself as he saw...a heart-stopping scene.

And that was great and all in translation...but where did all that essence come from?
If not from his planet, or Cosmos, it still had to be coming from somewhere as Noah couldn't just create- this would be going against the very fabric of Reality!
The Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics had to be followed.
Energy could neither be created nor destroyed, only changed into a different form.
And this...was the crux of why Noah was granted the title of <Infinite Conduit> after the mutation of his soul so long ago.
A Conduit was something that connected or exchanged something.
A Conduit to connect pipes of water or for wiring different forms of energy.

When Noah attained what he considered the full Reality altering Trait of Infinite Mana, he had transcended many concepts and made himself a Conduit that instantaneously exchanged different forms of essence into pure mana- pure Mana that he utilized an infinite amount of as he was not drawing it from himself, but from the outside!
To better understand this, the description of the Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics had to come into the picture.

It stated that "<Manadynamics classifies everything into its own domains and systems, where the total change in the essence of any system will always be equal to the Mana exchanged between the system and its surroundings, and the influence exerted by the system or on the system by an outside force.>"
Everything had its own domain and system.
One can imagine it akin to a bubble- where Noah and all the variety of other existences had their own bubbles that surrounded who they were, and that was their domain.
Stellar bodies have their own systems and domains that adhered to the Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics.
The vast Realities had their own systems and domains!
The 9 Dimensions had their own systems and domains!

The Desolate Mausoleum...has its own Domain where its total change of essence was always equal to the Mana exchanged between it and its surroundings, and the influence exerted by it or on it by an outside force!
What Noah had done was something critical where the energy he utilized and transformed did not come from his own system.
His reserves of Mana did not remain enclosed within his own bubble of domain.
The first few times he pierced this bubble was with his Planet and then Galaxy and then Universe as he utilized the Domains and systems of other entities.

This was outside of the boundaries of what existences were supposed to do, but since he still utilized this energy and transformed it into skills and abilities that returned their essence back into the surroundings as the Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics returned everything where it should be...he still had not violated this Fundamental Natural Law!
HUUUM!
As Noah was lost in this epiphany while gazing at the description of this Law, his Main Body pulsed with a unique sensation as Resonance of Nature shone brightly.
His stellar visage with two Dimensional Layers illuminated as his Tri-Pupiled eyes released rays of light.

His sight seemed to be cleared up as while releasing luminous light that made his pupils seem like three blazing suns, he gazed upon the surroundings after gaining an understanding in the Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics.
He saw the vast Dimensional Holy Land and the Seas of multicolored Essence within it...but he saw even more than that.

He saw how these Seas of essence weren't just increasing in density and volume out of nowhere, with immaculate and unseen cracks in space leaking out white streams of essence that transformed into Seas of golden Destiny or verdant life force!
He moved even further to gaze upon his people as his eyes landed on the vibrantly glorious body of Halcyon.
As her golden hair flowed over her shoulders while she trained, Noah could see a massive bubble of golden light around her.

It contained robust forms of swirling energies that she breathed in and out constantly without her knowledge, and any time she cast a skill, some of the energy within her golden bubble would be taken and transformed to enact her skill in the outside world!
The skill of a flash of golden lightning was cast as it cracked apart space, but then soon enough, it faded.
It faded and turned into streams of unseen essence that assimilated into the surroundings.
And when Noah gazed back at her, the energies within her bubble were reduced.
But soon after...her bubble pulsed as energy from the surroundings began to flow into it!
To fill up the Essence that was just used and transformed into something else that returned to the surroundings.
Her own body also pulsed as it attracted this essence even faster, this being her Value of Mana Regeneration that affected this!
WAA!
It was a flow of energy.
Everything was accounted for.
Neither created nor destroyed, only changed into a different form.
<An Astounding Achievement!>
<You are gazing upon the very workings of the Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics as your understanding is further increased by an additional 5%!>
The prompt rained down but Noah wasn't gazing at it.
He gazed at other beings as he saw a slightly larger golden bubble around the Emperor Penguin, a massive bubble around Little Henry, and a smaller bubble around the Shadow Guard Night.
After he gazed at his surroundings and others, he came to himself.
His eyes turned to himself as he saw...a heart-stopping scene.

chapters.title: Chapter 1954
paragraphs: Noah had gazed at the Dimensional Holy Land that had its own massive bubble of domain, and the bubbles of domains of his own people stretched throughout it training!
But when he turned his gaze to himself...he couldn't see it.

He couldn't see a massive bubble of any color around him, where even if it was massive in size compared to others, it should have still been there as he expanded his sight for miles and then light-years to find it!
But it wasn't there.
The only thing he could see as a bubble of a domain was within his body.
He saw an abstract of a small golden bubble within his vibrant origin that contained none other than the Dream Essence.
A green bubble that contained Prana Essence.
A multicolored bubble that showed his reserves of the Essence of Reality.
And a variety of other golden bubbles that contained many of his different forms of essence!
The only bubble or domain missing...was the main domain of Mana that everyone had.
He did not have his own Domain or system that contained his Mana.
WAA!

When Noah raised his hands to call forth an ability that he had yet to nullify the resource cost of, he saw his body light up as from his surroundings...essence converged into him and brought the skill to fruition before it faded back into essence soon after.
The surroundings weren't affected in the slightest as next, he called forth <Bloodfiend> while putting in trillions of Mana in exchange!

If his vision from before or anyone else looked, they wouldn't be able to see any changes. But under his new gaze, he saw the bubble of the Dimensional Holy Land have its essence surge towards him while the thin imperceptible cracks that released an unknown white essence sent a few of its streams as in a mere instant, it turned into seas of mana as the cost of the skill was paid.
The essence surged through Noah and formed the concept he had in his mind as he...acted as a Conduit.
A massive demonic figure with a sea of blood behind it appeared above Noah.

It released a horrific pressure as Noah released it soon after, observing as the vibrant essence that made it disappear back into the Dimensional Holy Land. The imperceptible cracks pulled in droves of the Seas of essence that turned back into white streams that disappeared silently.
His Aspects of Existence began to tremble as his body moved unconsciously.
HUUUM!
Towards the nearest imperceptible crack that nobody could see!
The supremely pure white essence being released from this seemed small in volume but could instantly transform into trillions of pure Mana!
His hand moved towards it as when he was close to it and tried to grasp it...
BZZZT!
He felt an arc of light bounce him back as he received a heavy jolt, a prompt rising before his eyes.
<You do not have enough authority.>
The prompt did not have a text box as its words were a piercing pure white that dripped with authority and power.
Noah's eyes turned sharp.
His pupils span maddeningly as he reached out again, the will of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor not simply content to agree after seeing a prompt once!
HOONG!
But...
BOOM!
He was rebounded off with even more force as yet another dazzling set of white words rose.
<You do not have enough Authority of Quintessence.>
His eyes opened wide as many thoughts bloomed!
Authority of Quintessence!
Authority of this current Age!
Wasn't Noah building this up with his crown and backbone of a throne?
This...was what was required to grasp or even control this unseen white essence that could seemingly turn into any resource?!
There were many more questions and answers as Noah found out even more of the secrets around him, this time his mind being brought to with Lavalliere's voice.
<This should be something that you can grasp when you attain the Seat of the True Emperor.>
WAA!
<With it, anything is possible. Breaking the shackles that bind an existence, keeping the balance of Manadynamics, unheard of possibilities for any actions the past True Emperors carried out.>
A shocking revelation was laid down.
When Noah believed he had gained the true reality-altering concept of Infinite Mana, he was not wrong in this belief.
He had access to Infinite Mana.

His domain and system was not there as he was not limited in the reserves of Mana! Whichever bubble or domain he entered, it would adhere to give him what was required. And if there was any discrepancy, a supremely unique white essence would make up for it to make sure that the Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics was not violated!
Lost within his voice, Lavalliere's voice continued.

<But after the actions of the Last True Emperor, the actions of this supreme authority...will eventually not be capable of rectifying the constant emergence of new Realities and expansion of Dimensions. Eventually, everything will crumble apart.>
Bundles of information were descending upon Noah as at the center of it all was the Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics.
There was also the Fundamental Natural Law of Entropy that was gaining in too much authority as ultimately, with it came destruction!
But there was time.
Time for Noah to understand and still gain whatever authority was required.
His Tri-Pupiled eyes shone with an even brighter luster as he focused on the understanding of Manadynamics once more.
As he focused on the concept of <Infinite Conduit> that he had made himself to be by the erasure of his bubble/domain!

<Infinite Conduit>:: You have been acting as a Conduit for immense transfers of essence instantaneously as your Aspects of Existence have gained a unique standing due to the mutation in your soul. When grasping enough understanding of the Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics, you will gain the capability to turn your mutation into the Heart of Mana. Furthermore, &@#$%^*(!$*%...
Heart of Mana.
Heart of Destiny, Heart of Karma, and a few more!
As always, grand possibilities opened up before Noah's eyes as he alone would choose how to proceed and what effects his actions would bring.
The concepts he was dabbling in right now were too pristine as he had to take a step back and look at them in their entirety.

His main body would continue this task as he forged the Second Dimensional Layer while his Clones would continue their Incursions across Dimensions and Realities...until he gained whatever level of authority required that nothing could be veiled before his eyes!
SHAA!

The Clone of Alexander in the Empyral Domain of Nature finally stepped out of its raging waves of essence, his dark hair whipping around his head in a magnetized fashion as his eyes carried a devilish and unstoppable charm.

He gazed out to see Akaris, Katelyn, and Juliette standing beside a cerulean rift as with his entrance- Akaris rose as her aura was no longer at the 9th Firmament of Ascendancy, and nor was Juliette's!
Only Katelyn remained at the stage she was as she gazed towards Noah.
But as always, Akaris took the lead as the wings below her feet spread out wide, her voice echoing out.
"Your gains were sufficient?"
Noah's visage was hard to look at as he reigned in his authority and replied.
"Somewhat."
"Good. There is a Dream Master to hunt."

chapters.title: Chapter 1955
paragraphs: Across the Domains of Primordials, Dream Masters of the Dream Dimension had begun to spread out with their forces!
These existences were not in the stage of LEGENDS as they had formed a Haven.
They had their own genuine Grotto Haven as under the vast Realities, they were unmatched!
They had Legions led by Ultima Strata LEGENDs, with some exceptionally powerful Dream Masters even having other Grotto Haven existences under them as they made up a core power of a Dimensional Ruler.

Such were the beings beginning to permeate through the vast Realities in the last few hours as when Noah gained the information on their movements, his heart didn't have the least bit of fear and apprehension.
There was only the thought of loot!
"Before we go..."
As his eyes illuminated while thinking of what was to come, he nodded towards Katelyn as she waved her hands to bring forth a crystalline mirror before her.
Within a microsecond, fair hands reached out from it as the visage of another Katelyn could be seen, remaining inside the mirror as this Mirror Clone gazed towards Noah!
"Adjudicator Katelyn promised to show me a little of the Mirror Dimension, an invasion won't stand in the way of that."
WAA!
As he spoke, his own figure fluctuated as an identical version of him was formed beside him, flying towards the glimmering silver mirror where another Katelyn was waiting!

"This won't affect your battle power?" Juliette's eyes shone as she asked, still bent on finding a strong man to put under her as she watched a Clone of Noah delve into the dazzling mirror with another Katelyn, this small gateway beginning to close soon after as Noah shook his head.
"Merely a Clone for reconnaissance. Let's go."
He shook off their gazes as he sent a True Sanguine Clone and what seemed like Katelyn's Mirror Clone, but it was actually her main body...into a gateway leading to the Mirror Dimension.

Akaris merely gazed at this scene as she floated towards the portal before them, the four of them entering it to join the Legion that was bound to set off and stand against the forces of the Dream Dimension!
SHAA!
The constant shifting and sliding of mirrors could be felt all around him as Noah followed the lead of Katelyn while she tested apart the veils of the Mirror Dimension.

He had his Clones and will moving across many locations as he sought the Sword of Avalon in the Avalon Dimension, War and Conquest in the Dream and Apollyon Dimension, and now there was the Mirror Dimension that had also been a part of his plans.
Here...he wanted to conduct a coup!
But before that...
"Most of the geniuses who went in the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest and survived have formed their Realities. I waited as destiny pointed me to something else after our talk."
Katelyn spoke as the mirrors around them constantly shifted, the scenes of their surroundings gradually becoming clearer as a mirror castle unveiled itself before them.
Noah had a smile on his face as he asked lightly.
"Have you made your decision?"
A crucial and life changing decision after their talk from last time.

Katelyn's eyes flashed with a glorious silver light as the ecritures of <SACRALIZED EMPEROR> shone brightly around her crown, a piece of the Mirror floor they stood on breaking and floating upwards to bring them to the terrace of the castle.
Katelyn turned her back towards Noah and walked into the castle with determination as she replied.

"Yes. Let me have a taste of this power that everyone seeks. You haven't fully obtained my heart as I shall leave that to time, but I cannot deny the methods you mentioned as for now...you have to be satisfied with just my body."

Inside the terrace that led into a dazzling and wide mirror room within this castle, Katelyn entered while turning around to face Noah- the silver battle dress around her beginning to fade away as Noah floated into this mirror castle without a hurry.
"Before all that, let's have you be a triple Limit Breaker first."

Rays of resplendent light bloomed out as <Empyral Physique Refining Pearls>, <Ionized Soul Seas>, and a single <Grotto Panacea> appeared behind Noah- his plans moving as he wished in another aspect as he looked forward to performing Cultivation with another Dimensional Royalty!
Hecate Eranelon had granted him a Dimensional Physique and a Royal Dimensional Bloodline while the Cultivation session had raised her from the Beta Strata and into the Alpha Strata.
After making Katelyn a Limit Breaker in all her Aspects of Existence and performing Dual Cultivation with her, how much would her power be raised?
How great would the continuing changes in the Infinite Dream Physique be after yet another Physique from a different Dimension was assimilated into it?

There was much for Noah to look forward to as he watched the countless reflections of a vivacious and innocent existence reflect on the countless mirrors of the castle he stepped into, the dazzling silver hair flowing from Katelyn's head and draping over her shoulders smoothly being grasped in his fingers as like a hungry wolf, he went in for a delectable meal!

Meanwhile, Akaris led his clone of Alexander and the Mirror Clone of Katelyn along with Juliette across multiple gateways that eventually took them out of the vast and mystical Main Reality- coming out on one of the gateways stationed within the Boundary Between Realities that was packed with massive vessels and Adjudicator Legions protecting the boundary of the Main Reality.

Buy when Noah gazed at the surroundings, he found something different from when they first passed through here as now...the volume and the sheer number of beings in this area had astoundingly quadrupled and seemed to only be increasing.
Even more Vessels were present as more and more were flying into this region, the Adjudicator Legions moving busily as within these vessels, Noah could see a myriad of Primordial Bloodlines.

"The peripheral explored Realities and Domains of Primordials are compromised for now as Primordial Bloodlines are migrating towards the Main Reality for protection. The Dimensional Forces moving about are not taking any prisoners as Realities are being torn down like weeds."
Akaris spoke slowly while the four of them floated towards a massive vessel where Representative Aileron was waiting along with another even more powerful existence.
A migration.
Because of the actions of the Dream Dimensional Races, multiple Bloodlines were forced to migrate as the destruction they lay in their wake was astounding!

chapters.title: Chapter 1956
paragraphs: It was a fantastical scene to see as among the many massive vessels flowing in, the vast majority were pulsing with blue and purple light as powerful souls wrapped up in shining battle suits led the way forward.

"The Spirit Race stepped up to handle most of the issues of transportation with their Techno Relics, but we still have to do our part to stop the Dimensional forces from forging further inward as their path seems to be set on the Main Reality."
The voice of Akaris rang in their ears as they arrived on their own designated Relic.

The scenes of the proud and powerful Primordial Bloodlines leaving their homes in mass exodus were unique to see as it wouldn't just be lesser Primordial Races like the Royal Wolves or Spirit Race, but even the regions of the Pure-Blooded Domains of the 5 Bloodline Races might be pushed back if the advancement of the Dream Dimensional Races wasn't stopped!
With all this in the picture, how would Primordial ls handle this?
It meant that Noah would get to see a genuine grasp of just how powerful their forces are- what the followers of the existence who had split apart the Main Reality!

Destiny weaved powerfully as they stepped onto their own massive vessel, Noah gazing at the massive DHARMA construct that seemed like a moving Reality with its own complex weaponry. It had multiple Legions already situated within it as at the helm, Representative Aileron was speaking with a stellar haired woman whose body retained features of a Reality Ursidae!
Her body gave off dangerous waves of power as the illusion of multiple Realities stacked atop each other could be seen.

A radiant multicolored solidified crown that read <EMPEROR> spun above her as apart from Representative Aileron, multiple auras of other Ultima Strata existences could be felt aboard this vessel as they led powerful Legions!
At their entrance, the Reality Ursidae gazed towards them along with Representative Aileron and the others.
"The oh-so-important chicks that delayed our deployment finally arrived?"
HUUUM!
The vibrant will of a Haven descended as the DHARMA Relic they were on lit up, Akaris stepping forward to give a respectful nod while replying calmly!
"Suzerain Jiyeon, our apologies. It was an unavoidable situation that involved an Empyral Domain of Nature."

Her voice didn't carry a servile tone or even a hint of fear as it caused the eyes of the existence who had gained the title of Suzerain to flash with a sharp light as she gazed towards a slightly helpless Representative Aileron coldly!
<Suzerain>.
A title and standing granted by those who had achieved the Grotto Haven Realm as it stood for a Ruler that reigned autonomously above many others!
It far exceeded any Obsidian Adjudicator or Adjudicator Commander as a <Suzerain> could command Ultima Strata LEGENDs and their Legions.
Jiyeon was a particularly brutal Suzerain from the Pure-Blooded Reality Ursidae Bloodline, Noah's eyes landing on her cold and hard to read figure as information rose up.
<Name>: Suzerain Jiyeon
<Lineage>: Reality Ursidae
<Realm>: Grotto Haven
<Titles>: Soul Crusher, Fist Emperor...
<True Reality Vitality Values>: 8,645 Billion
<Innate Grotto Barrier>: 2,580 Billion
<Reserves of Essence of Reality>: 93 Million
<Mana>: 850 Trillion
<Destiny>: 35 <Fate>: 39...
<Overall Battlepower>: Grotto Haven
'What a tank...'
There was a decent amount of information to unpack, but the most astounding information to come across was this existence's True Vitality Values!
8,646 Billion!

Noah had barely broken into the hundreds of Billions that Ultima Strata existences should also be at, where if things went according to what was currently expected- the peak of Ultima Strata should be at 1,000 Billion as reaching and exceeding that number would be something delving into the stage of Grotto Haven.
1,000 Billion- or simply 1 Trillion!
Yet this existence before his eyes had over 8 Trillion in Damage Values as she was one of the sturdier tanks Noah had come across so far.
It made him expectant for the things to come as this Suzerain Jiyeon shone powerfully while speaking out without delay.
"Set off!"
HUUUM!
The DHARMA Relic pulsed.

The Essence of Gravitation leaked from it as space became twisted, a dazzling flash of purple light wrapping around this entire vessel that held multiple Primordial Legions led by Ultima Strata LEGENDs and commanded by a Grotto Haven Realm existence as it disappeared in a flash of purple light soon after!

In the surroundings, the exodus of many existences leaving their homes and surging towards the Main Reality continued, the periphery of many Primordial Domains experiencing this phenomenon as Realities were getting shattered and stepped in such large numbers as if they were grains of sand upon a desert!
In a region within the Boundary Between Realities.
The remnants of shattered Prime Realities lay as a massive Amalgamation of golden sand formed into the visage of a feline creature with a wicked smile on its face could be seen breathing in.
Every time it did this, the light of the fractured Realities and any existences scrambling away were pulled towards it and devoured in its mouth in a horrific manner!

Behind it, Seas of golden sand roiled as they carried forth Dream LEGENDS at Ultima Strata and below- the massive feline like existence made of golden sand being a Dream Master under the Dimensional Ruler- The Longest Dream!
"Nothing here about the Enemy of the Dimension. Keep forging forward!"
OOOOH!
A bellow released from it in the form of a command as its aura was undeniable, a Haven surrounding its body as this was another existence that could be considered a Suzerain.
His forces were about to surge forward when all of a sudden, the Decretum of Dreams around this Suzerain trembled as its gaze turned into shock in the next second.
This gaze...barely turned upwards to see in the next instant that a massive rift had opened up above them- a rift that had a titanic visage of a foot descending towards them!
A foot!
It surged with shocking light and power that could decimate everything- a power that made this Grotto Haven Dream tremble as it surpassed anything in its imagination.
The only thing it could say as it gazed up at this astounding descending foot was...
"You...shouldn't be here-!"
WAA!
The foot descended with an authority of immense contempt and destruction as deadly bursts of the Essence of Natural Laws surrounded it!

chapters.title: Chapter 1957
paragraphs: A foot!
Wrapped around destructive tendrils of the Essence of Natural Laws, it descended upon an extremely powerful Dream Master who was under the Dimensional Ruler- The Longest Dream!
By no means was this Suzerain not powerful.
Being a Dream Master, it meant he had begun to peer at the truth of the Absolute Dream Authority as common Grotto Haven existences could not touch this being.
So this descending foot that made the very soul of a Suzerain Dream Master tremble?
It stemmed from someone exceptional.
HOOONG!

The shattered Realities pulsed as the Decretum of Dreams surged around the Dream Master even in his disbelief, but the descending foot continued down as it covered the massive figure of the Dream Master and the Legions behind it.
"OOOOH!"
An amalgamation of HERESEY rose around the Dream Master to defend, but it was shockingly nothing in the face of this foot as it was broken down along with its body at an extremely fast pace!

As this occurred, the area behind the Dream Master that had been painted with the sandy gold essence of the Dream Dimension trembled as massive fissures erupted, a bellowing Authority beginning to surge out.
"Impudence!"
it surged out with wondrous tendrils of Absolute Dream Authority, but against the descending foot that had acted first, it was too late.
BOOM!

Horrific waves of destruction permeated outwards as the small wisps of Absolute Dream Authority wrapping around the Dream Master became eradicated along with its Aspects of Existence, and all of the Legions being led by Ultima and Alpha Strata LEGENDS behind it that were covered by the titanic descending foot!
A Dream Master shockingly and unbelievably fell in a single strike.
"You dare?! You dare to make a move against those weaker than you?!"
WAA!
The terrifying authority that had surged out to try and prevent the early death of a Dream Master was profound and glorious.
It coagulated into a mass of swirling Dream Authority as every single particle of the Decretum of Dreams in the surroundings fell under its control.
It was the authority of a Dimensional Ruler.
It was the Longest Dream!
The visage of the descended foot pulsed as it was pulled up, a voice filled with coldness and confidence echoing out.
"You invade and destroy my home and expect me not to make a move because the enemies are weaker? Foolish dreamer. Either come out or get the fuck out so I can eradicate the rest."
Boundless coldness and a sense of contempt against a visage of a Dimensional Ruler!
"A mere dog dares to be so bold? A mere Follower of a Named One?!"
HOONG!
Absolute Dream Authority erupted as the Longest Dream made a move.

It had not expected to be making a move so soon as it expected champions of Primordials to be sent to go against its Dream Masters, its role being to keep in check the most powerful combatants on their side.
Yet one such powerful combatant had made a move too quickly and incurred the great loss of a Dream Master!
Followers of the Named Ones.
Those who studied and moved under the banner of the existences exalted by Primordials- those that were only a level lower than the Great OPPENHEIMER!
They had begun to move.
Followers of the Named Ones may be apprehensive and not match up to the powerful Dimensional Rulers within their Dimensions, but when facing against their amalgamated wills in the vast Realities?
BOOOM!
They were not fearful as the stellar foot flashed to barely reflect the visage of a massive stellar humanoid whose eyes alone released the blinding light of too many Realities.
Crimson gold true blood formed into rivers as fragments of Realities floated across the Boundary Between Realities.
Husks of Dream LEGENDS and Nightmares could be seen as golden sand flowed listlessly in these bloody rivers in many regions.
Existences that had been sleeping over eons opened their eyes as they felt the weaving of the Age of Quintessence start off with a bang.

The forces of the Dream Dimension were innumerable as they permeated across many regions of the Primordial Domains-with many forces condensed in the domains outside of the Pure-Blooded RealityUrsidae and Royal Human Domains, but the forces of the Lineage that had the valor of the Last True Emperor was not to be looked down upon as the advancement of these forces was stopped within mere hours, Legions of Primordials expertly sent out exactly where they needed to be!

Like the weaving of an unseen net that was controlled by someone in the background, Legions were deployed in a manner that caused even these innumerable forces of the Dream Dimension to come to a halt.
If they wanted to proceed forward once more, they would have to overcome these Legions.
Outside of the Pure-Blooded Domains of the Reality Ursidae.
ZAP!

The massive stellar vessel carrying multiple Legions under the banner of Suzerain Jiyeon bloomed on the Frontlines as they appeared behind a defensive wall with massive Reality Ursidae moving in the distance, tendrils of gold sands being seen from afar as battle here was already underway.

"Our target is the one commanding the cluster of Dream Legions here, a Dream Master that our forces have come across before- The Nightwalker. We'll be coordinating with 4 other Suzerain Legions to take down this Nightmare before he is strengthened even more by delving into the souls of our people."
Suzerain Jiyeon spoke as her body pulsed with power.
Adjudicator Legions, Obsidian Adjudicator Legions, and then Suzerain Adjudicator Legions!
Led by prominent Grotto Haven Masters, Suzerain Legions were a core power of the Primordials as 5 of such Legions were placed to fight against a single Dream Master!

The vessel they were on surged towards where the battle was taking place as grotesque Nightmares could be seen in the distance weaving between realms of Dream and reality while battling different Legions of Pure-Blooded Primordials.

Their forces shone with black and gold colors as they seemed like a massive ocean that stretched back endlessly, a powerful aura situated at the center of all this as it was a titanic Nightmare releasing horrendous waves of power that surged towards four different directions.
Towards the Suzerains of the 4 other Legions that had already arrived here.

And now, a fifth one was entering the fray as the many eyes of the Nightwalker Dream Master turned towards the direction of Suzerain Jiyeon who disembarked the vessel along with the many Legions led by Ultima Strata LEGENDs with her.

Her body glimmered with a stellar light as she surged forward, two Legions backing her sides as her body enlarged into a massive Reality Ursidae, an illusory form of a DHARMA erupting above her as a Purple winged Reality Ursidae wielding crackling balls of thundering light manifested!

Noah observed this and many more scenes as he was under the Legion led by the Ultima Strata Representative Aileron- this being moving with surgical precision to enter the defense lines of Pure-Blooded Primordials before then to reinforce while the rest of the Legions backed Suzerain Jiyeon as she joined the fray.

The goal for her and the other 4 Suzerain Grotto Haven Masters was to withstand the attacks of The Nightwalker Dream Master while forging a path forward until ultimately, they destroyed everything about him.

"Stay close together and reinforce each other. Know your level of power and don't try to take on enemies you cannot. The crux of all this is to work together as in such a field of battle, individual results are negligible unless you are a Suzerain!"

Representative Aileron spoke out powerfully as Akaris and Juliette among others fused with their authority, Noah erupting with a devilish smile among them as his eyes swam with countless tendrils of destiny!

chapters.title: Chapter 1958
paragraphs: A bloody battlefield filled with countless existences.
This was something that Noah loved the most!
He couldn't consider himself a peace-loving person due to this as he genuinely thrived on chaos.

And at this moment, the unfolding chaos was grand as many Legions led by Ultima Strata LEGENDs could be seen stretched across the mass of black and gold that was a mixture of majority Nightmare and then Dream LEGENDS that seemed like an endless sea.
Nightmares in the forms of apparitions and obscene forms of Races.
Dream LEGENDS that shifted their forms with the endless grains of golden sand.
Their numbers accumulated in the hundreds of millions, and this was only in this region where a single Nightmare Dream Master was attacking!
It was a wonder to see as the whole area pulsed with the Decretum of Dreams!
And all of it...stood before Noah in a spectacular fashion.

The last time he displayed his power was in the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest as he was able to defeat an Alpha Strata LEGEND in the eyes of Primordials, and now days later...his main targets were not even beings of this level anymore!
What he sought were the most were Ultima Strata existences who had the most premium loot, Alpha Strata existences coming next as he could farm many Grotto Panaceas from them.

The more Grotto Panaceas he attained, the faster he could forge his Dimensional Layers and become even more powerful as he would utilize this unfolding war he was partly responsible for in the best possible manner.
"Let's go!"

Akaris bellowed out while Representative Aileron shone with incandescent light, diving towards a massive Iguana made of dreamy sand at the Ultima Strata while those below him surged to match the Alpha and Beta Strata Dream LEGENDS surrounding it.

REIFIED and DHARMA abilities unfurled all around as everywhere one looked, they would see battling beings falling one after another or others focused on their own battles that took many seconds as others even took minutes!
For Noah, a battle shouldn't be like this.
It shouldn't take you too many seconds to take care of your enemy as if it had to reach such a point, it meant you didn't prepare enough and were leaving the outcome of the battle up to Destiny.
No.
One had to be explosive when they battled.
They had to clear the fields and Seas of enemies as when those he was with joined the fray, they began to display such power!

After entering the stage of a LEGEND, Akaris had raised her power to not just be able to withstand a Beta Strata LEGEND- her dazzling abilities now reaching towards the Alpha Strata Realm as Juliette barely made it to Peak Beta.
Then there was Katelyn's Mirror Clone and him.

Katelyn's power was fluctuating as in the Mirror Castle within the Mirror Dimension that Noah had put under Time Dilation, he had successfully elevated her to be a Triple Limit Breaker as she was now Dual Cultivating with him while ascending to the stage of Primogenial LEGENDS...and it did not seem like this Dimensional Royalty would stop there!
When she joined the fray, countless mirrors bloomed to enclose dozens of Beta Strata Nightmares and even a single one at the Alpha Strata as her Clone moved to test her rising power.
Then there was Noah himself.
As he observed the larger span of the battle and the points where Ultima Strata LEGENDs like Representative Aileron moved, his breath calmed as his eyes captured many things.
When others made a move, they contributed to the battle as the stronger side would slowly show itself over time.
When Noah joined the battle, an untold supremacy would be expressed as he would not just contribute.
The Quintessential Kainos Emperor would dominate.
HUUUM!
His soul began to buzz as he silently thought.
'Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique.'
Interminable essence surged around him as he didn't even lift a finger.
He only spoke out loud two words as even the nearby Primordial felt a shiver course deep in their souls.
His Tri-Pupiled eyes shone as they released a radiant light of glory.
"First Form."
HUUM!
The space above him quaked as a Star of Illumination bloomed.
The destinies of nearby Ultima Strata existences rang out warning signs of danger as they turned their eyes towards his direction!

Their eyes and perception could barely see, but those of the Alpha Strata and below weren't even able to perceive it as this multi-target area of effect skill surged out with millions of volatile rays of severing light in the form of the Assassin Emperor of Severance!

After the boosts of Noah's base True Damage Values paired with the dual effect of the Throne of Quintessential Tyranny, the multipliers of his 180 Ascendancy Halos that he filled with TABOO Edicts that had undergone Concept Amalgamation, and the new boosts from the percentages in his Natural Laws of Reality and Decretum of Dimensions...it all came to grant Noah a ridiculous Damage Value of 170 Billion.

He had already exceeded the base 100 Billion of the Ultima Strata as this single cast of the First Form of the Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique caused some Ultima Strata existences to feel a great threat!
As for the Seas of targeted beings lesser than this level?
A glorious scene showed in their midst.
The dazzling gold and black lights that represented clusters of millions of Nightmares and Dream LEGENDS flickered.
Then they began to dwindle like fading twinkling lights that were snuffed out as they faced immediate and desolate destruction!

Millions of Primogenial LEGENDS, hundreds of Beta Strata LEGENDS, and dozens of immensely powerful Alpha Strata Legion Commanders perished as the sea of gold and black was fading for the entire region near Noah.

And it was even expanding outwards as the damage was extensive and horrendous to the point that even the eyes of the powerfully fighting all nearby Ultima Strata LEGENDs turned towards his direction, a particularly powerful Ultima Strata Dream LEGENDS in the form of a Gynosphinx roaring out as immense Dream Authority surged from it!
A wave of golden sand erupted as it came to blanket the shining Star of Illumination, this wave of Dream Essence carrying with it a few hundred Billion Damage Values.
The Star of Illumination was covered.
"ROAR!"
The Gynosphynx bellowed out as the golden waves of sand constricted and dissipated the Star of Illumination!
But the ferocity and power of battle in this region lulled.
The eyes of this Gynosphinx and many other Ultima Strata existences shone dangerously as they gazed in Noah's direction.
Representative Aileron had eyes of incredulity as he also turned towards Noah's direction!
The pace of the battle changed as the vast sea of black and gold that represented Nightmares and Dream LEGENDS...had a chunk that was dead and lifeless from the actions of a single combatant!!!
