Nightmares in the forms of apparitions and obscene forms of Races.
Dream LEGENDS that shifted their forms with the endless grains of golden sand.
Their numbers accumulated in the hundreds of millions, and this was only in this region where a single Nightmare Dream Master was attacking!
It was a wonder to see as the whole area pulsed with the Decretum of Dreams!
And all of it...stood before Noah in a spectacular fashion.

The last time he displayed his power was in the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest as he was able to defeat an Alpha Strata LEGEND in the eyes of Primordials, and now days later...his main targets were not even beings of this level anymore!
What he sought were the most were Ultima Strata existences who had the most premium loot, Alpha Strata existences coming next as he could farm many Grotto Panaceas from them.

The more Grotto Panaceas he attained, the faster he could forge his Dimensional Layers and become even more powerful as he would utilize this unfolding war he was partly responsible for in the best possible manner.
"Let's go!"

Akaris bellowed out while Representative Aileron shone with incandescent light, diving towards a massive Iguana made of dreamy sand at the Ultima Strata while those below him surged to match the Alpha and Beta Strata Dream LEGENDS surrounding it.

REIFIED and DHARMA abilities unfurled all around as everywhere one looked, they would see battling beings falling one after another or others focused on their own battles that took many seconds as others even took minutes!
For Noah, a battle shouldn't be like this.
It shouldn't take you too many seconds to take care of your enemy as if it had to reach such a point, it meant you didn't prepare enough and were leaving the outcome of the battle up to Destiny.
No.
One had to be explosive when they battled.
They had to clear the fields and Seas of enemies as when those he was with joined the fray, they began to display such power!

After entering the stage of a LEGEND, Akaris had raised her power to not just be able to withstand a Beta Strata LEGEND- her dazzling abilities now reaching towards the Alpha Strata Realm as Juliette barely made it to Peak Beta.
Then there was Katelyn's Mirror Clone and him.

Katelyn's power was fluctuating as in the Mirror Castle within the Mirror Dimension that Noah had put under Time Dilation, he had successfully elevated her to be a Triple Limit Breaker as she was now Dual Cultivating with him while ascending to the stage of Primogenial LEGENDS...and it did not seem like this Dimensional Royalty would stop there!
When she joined the fray, countless mirrors bloomed to enclose dozens of Beta Strata Nightmares and even a single one at the Alpha Strata as her Clone moved to test her rising power.
Then there was Noah himself.
As he observed the larger span of the battle and the points where Ultima Strata LEGENDs like Representative Aileron moved, his breath calmed as his eyes captured many things.
When others made a move, they contributed to the battle as the stronger side would slowly show itself over time.
When Noah joined the battle, an untold supremacy would be expressed as he would not just contribute.
The Quintessential Kainos Emperor would dominate.
HUUUM!
His soul began to buzz as he silently thought.
'Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique.'
Interminable essence surged around him as he didn't even lift a finger.
He only spoke out loud two words as even the nearby Primordial felt a shiver course deep in their souls.
His Tri-Pupiled eyes shone as they released a radiant light of glory.
"First Form."
HUUM!
The space above him quaked as a Star of Illumination bloomed.
The destinies of nearby Ultima Strata existences rang out warning signs of danger as they turned their eyes towards his direction!

Their eyes and perception could barely see, but those of the Alpha Strata and below weren't even able to perceive it as this multi-target area of effect skill surged out with millions of volatile rays of severing light in the form of the Assassin Emperor of Severance!

After the boosts of Noah's base True Damage Values paired with the dual effect of the Throne of Quintessential Tyranny, the multipliers of his 180 Ascendancy Halos that he filled with TABOO Edicts that had undergone Concept Amalgamation, and the new boosts from the percentages in his Natural Laws of Reality and Decretum of Dimensions...it all came to grant Noah a ridiculous Damage Value of 170 Billion.

He had already exceeded the base 100 Billion of the Ultima Strata as this single cast of the First Form of the Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique caused some Ultima Strata existences to feel a great threat!
As for the Seas of targeted beings lesser than this level?
A glorious scene showed in their midst.
The dazzling gold and black lights that represented clusters of millions of Nightmares and Dream LEGENDS flickered.
Then they began to dwindle like fading twinkling lights that were snuffed out as they faced immediate and desolate destruction!

Millions of Primogenial LEGENDS, hundreds of Beta Strata LEGENDS, and dozens of immensely powerful Alpha Strata Legion Commanders perished as the sea of gold and black was fading for the entire region near Noah.

And it was even expanding outwards as the damage was extensive and horrendous to the point that even the eyes of the powerfully fighting all nearby Ultima Strata LEGENDs turned towards his direction, a particularly powerful Ultima Strata Dream LEGENDS in the form of a Gynosphinx roaring out as immense Dream Authority surged from it!
A wave of golden sand erupted as it came to blanket the shining Star of Illumination, this wave of Dream Essence carrying with it a few hundred Billion Damage Values.
The Star of Illumination was covered.
"ROAR!"
The Gynosphynx bellowed out as the golden waves of sand constricted and dissipated the Star of Illumination!
But the ferocity and power of battle in this region lulled.
The eyes of this Gynosphinx and many other Ultima Strata existences shone dangerously as they gazed in Noah's direction.
Representative Aileron had eyes of incredulity as he also turned towards Noah's direction!
The pace of the battle changed as the vast sea of black and gold that represented Nightmares and Dream LEGENDS...had a chunk that was dead and lifeless from the actions of a single combatant!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 1959
paragraphs: When entering a battle, the Quintessential Kainos Emperor wasn't just like any other droves that moved to find an enemy to match!
He would gradually make this battle his own as eventually, he would become the Quintessential decider of its pace and result.
For those who knew him, there were results of shock and incredulity.
For those seeing him for the first time, there was also incredulity!
The Dream and Nightmare LEGENDs at the Ultima Strata focused their eyes on him as the massive Gynosphinx was soon accompanied by another two Ultima Strata LEGENDs to focus their wills here.
Seeing such a destructive being on the battlefield, they couldn't let him be.
"Move and protect!"
WAA!

The voice of Representative Aileron boomed out as he saw the target of three Ultima Strata LEGENDs change from Primordial Representatives to Noah, his eyes shining sharply as a massive golden DHARMIC idol rose above him.
It was the form of a humanoid Dragon Phoenix wielding flaming horns of golden splendor that shot out towards the Gynosphinx and others that were surging forward!
But this wasn't all.
Noah's single action had one more far-reaching repercussion as he eradicated Millions of Dream and Nightmare LEGENDs in a single blow.
Far, far in the distance, the massive apparition of the Suzerain Dream Master, The Nightwalker...this being gave a brief glance towards this direction.
Its body was the most massive thing on the battlefield as the 5 Primordial Suzerains matching it in five different directions were still a bit smaller in size.
Obsidian sands surrounded it as it seemed humanoid in nature, and yet the sands constantly moved in forms that reminded one of nightmarish Beasts.
Its apparition was holding a massive constantly changing black sword with jagged stellar edges of Reality, golden sands making its hilt while Obsidian nightmarish sands made its blade.

After gazing at the recent scene and the opposing sea of Primordials, a light of ingenuity and brutality shone within The Nightwalker as he grasped his massive nightmarish sword and called out with a guttural voice.
"Cataclysmic Unity Nightmare Sword."
BZZT!
The massive sword in its hands hummed.
The essence of HERESY surged.
The Decretum of Dreams vibrated and surged as the expression of Suzerain Jiyeon and the others changed!
Behind The Nightwalker, countless forms of flaming black illusory swords bloomed.
Countess swords that in the next instant rushed together to fuse into a single point- forming a massive Obsidian nightmare sword that was one-eighth the size of this whole battlefield!
It aimed at the vast Seas of Primordials opposing the sea of black and gold Dreams and Nightmares.
"Intercept!"
A Suzerain with the form of a massive Willow Tree bellowed out as his body released countless branches of illusory light.
Singularities of seeds constantly bloomed from these branches into dazzling rivers of Realities that surged forward!
Suzerain Jiyeon also bellowed out as a DHARMIC figure of herself manifested above her, her pure fists shining with flames of Reality as they thundered towards the <Cataclysmic Unity Nightmare Sword>!
The 5 Primordial Suzerains moved to intercept such a shocking blow as it would threaten to wipe out a huge cluster of their forces if they couldn't stop it.
The pace of the battle had changed.
The cause of it was a single being as his first action caused things to heat up and force beings to display their most powerful concepts!
Deadly waves of concepts screaming of Natural Laws of Reality and Decretum of Dimensions surged above them as they boasted Damage Values in the Trillions.
This was a battle that the Grotto Haven Suzerains would dominate as if any of them fell, it would decide where victory went.
As their stellar abilities weaved in the skies, Noah's heart felt a fantastical pull.
This was it.
The feeling of battle.
The rush of essence and blood coursing through one's blood as every microsecond counted!
HUUM!
At this juncture, a symphony began to thrum like the beat of a heart.
BOOM...BOOM...BA!
A symphony of horns of battle and the melody of a hero facing insurmountable odds!
The gazes of many nearby beings looked around as defensive skills wrapped around their ears.
Was someone attacking their auditory senses?
The Primordials felt their blood burn and their bodies blaze with power when this symphony vibrated around them.
The Dream and Nightmare LEGENDs instead felt a demoralizing sensation wrap over them in a shocking fashion as truth be told, no side knew what was going on with the newly rising symphony!
The horns of battle resounded out as Noah's blood rushed with even more splendor as he felt even more robust and powerful!
At such a juncture, his figure took on a stance as his left arm swung forward while his right arm pointed back.
His legs took on a mesmerizing stance as he breathed in, essence surging from his surroundings and entering the soles of his feet as they circulated throughout his body.
HUUM!
Vibrant waves of the Essence of the Decretum of Dreams surged around him as they were masked and silent!
But with their movement, a silent wave of HERESY formed.
HERESY!
As two particularly powering Ultima Strata Nightmares came towards him led by a Gynosphinx, Noah's visage flashed as he called out calmly.
"Second Form."
<Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique- Second Form> was called out!
But just what exactly did it entail?!
The First Form of the Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Techniques was the combining of two skills to produce a multitarget Area of Effect ability with a deadly single chain effect.
Its Damage value wasn't truly amplified that much as for this aspect, we have to turn our eyes towards the Second Form.
When it came to the effects of Skill Succession. Noah could continue the chain of his linked skills, or he could form an entirely new chain if he wished.
For the 3 Linked abilities and 4 Linked abilities, they could be any combination he wished for as after they were born- he could designate them as the Second Form or Third Form!

Since the two linked abilities of Ascendant Severing Soul Star and Assassin Emperor of Severance were 2 linked abilities that made the <First Form>, Noah could go in sequence and have a 3 Linked ability for the <Second Form> and then a 4 linked ability for the <Third Form>- or he could make multiple 3 Linked abilities and give them the labels of Second and Third Forms.

This was because 3 Linked abilities cost 100 Million Units of the Essence of Reality while 4 Linked abilities cost 500 Million! So at this point in time, he couldn't utilize 4 Linked abilities even if he made them as these abilities ignored any resource cancelation, reduction, or nullification. They had to be paid in full!
With this in mind, Noah chose three skills for Succession.
It wasn't anything overly complicated.
He kept the initial sequence of Ascendant Severing Soul Star and Assassin Emperor of Severance.
He just...added Fireball.
He just added the REIFIED form of Fireball- the Saintess of Fiery Damnation!

chapters.title: Chapter 1960
paragraphs: Noah didn't know what to expect when forming the first 3 Linked ability, but the results were something his main body was privy to first hand as they were stellar.
They were glorious!

[Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique- Second Form]:: An amalgamation of 3 REIFIED abilities of the Star of Illumination, Assassin Emperor of Severance, and the Saintess of Fiery Damnation. It has brought to fruition the ability <Unparalleled Emperor's Blitzkrieg>. Your body becomes wrapped with the force of a star that is formed by the Essence of Gravitation, capable of being moved in a set sequence and shape as you will. The star around you is further reinforced by the Decretum of Dreams as it blazes with Dream Extermination Flames. Your figure can be propelled with the Essence of Gravitation as any who stand in your way will be burnt by the Dream Extermination Flames, and those in the immediate surroundings will further face a triple chain of volatile severing soul light. After your movement that establishes the pre-set sequence or shape, a DHARMIC form of it remains entrenched in reality as it pulls in enemies with a cataclysmic Gravitational force to be burned with Dream Extermination Flames and an extra chain of severing soul light, the Unparalleled Emperor's Blitzkrieg ultimately ending in an explosive shower of grandeur and might. The final output Damage Value of this ability is set to a minimum of 500 Billion True Dimensional Damage Values after accounting for your base boosts and multipliers. This minimum Damage can change and fluctuate in the future depending on your own base Damage and multipliers. Currently pre-set movement of the Blitzkrieg- Lemniscate. Cost to cast: 100 Million Units of the Essence of Reality and 1 Trillion Mana.
Yes.
An ability that no matter what Noah's final damage output was after his base values and multipliers, it would release at a minimum of 500 Billion True Dimensional Damage Values!
When Noah increased his power in the days to come as his output became 600 Billion or even more, this ability would reflect that.
But its main wonders were the fact that it attributed a Natural Law and a Decretum.
It could be considered an ability of HERESY and at the same time...a DHARMIC ability!
"Second Form."
WA! WA! WA!
The symphony picked up the pace as 100 Million Units of the Essence of Reality were burned at once.
Essence coiled and tumbled as the Natural Law of Gravitation bloomed around Noah in his mesmerizing stance.
His body became surrounded by a blinding light as he became the center point of a singularity.
There was no star of Illumination.
He was the shining star!
BZZT!
Every friendly near him was pushed away by a terrifying Gravitational force as the temperature around him turned blazing hot, space itself melting as his visage could no longer be seen.
It was covered by a golden light of a star was burned with tendrils of Dream Extermination Flames, his form only flickering like an illusion to be seen every now and then!
This was just the start up of the skill.
Its true usage would just now be employed as this was a movement attack type skill centered around Noah.
This was the Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique- Second Form.
<Unparalleled Emperor's Blitzkrieg>!
SHIING!
He shot out like an incandescent star of light.
Into the surging waves of the Sea of Black and Gold.
Into the depths of the enemy's Legions.

His left hand was outstretched in front of him as his right hand was behind him, each one coiling with a different Gravitational pull that caused the golden star and flames Noah was in to be tinged with the purple of the Natural Law of Gravitation!
He delved into the mass of Dream and Nightmare LEGENDs as the moment he appeared and began to move with the pull of gravity, everything in his surroundings was burnt into Oblivion.
But this wasn't all.

Those in the immediate surroundings who weren't in Noah's path of the Blitzkrieg felt their souls shudder as radiant purple-gold rays of light shot out, smashing into them with 500 Billion True Dimensional Damage Values as they went to chain another 2 times!

This occurred everywhere Noah passed in the sea of Nightmare and Dream LEGENDS as he conducted a charge that to others- it seemed like a blinding mass of gold and purple releasing tendrils of cataclysmic flames and rays of light was moving and burning Millions of the invaders from the Dream Dimension.
The most unique thing was that the path of this Blitzkrieg- the path of this star...it left behind a dazzling gold and purple linear form behind it that was enacting a shape!
A shape...that would ultimately form a Lemniscate.
An infinity symbol!
"OOOOH!"
Sending the obscene danger and Damage Values that reached half a Trillion, the Gynosphinx that was already moving after Noah saw his charge into their Legions as its figure flashed.

An Alpha Strata LEGEND that would have met with Noah's charge exploded into pure Dream Essence as the Gynosphinx appeared in its place, Seas of Dream Essence surging and forming into golden wings of blinding light that reinforced the Gynosphinx as its jaws opened to release a breath of pure Dream Essence.
Towards the shining star coming his way.

The surge of flaming Dream Essence smashed onto the path of the Unparalleled Emperor's Blitzkrieg as wondrously, they were absorbed and dissipated by the Dream Extermination Flames as the charge continued.
Towards the Gynosphinx that had put itself on the path of this charge.
WA! WA! WA!
The symphony paved ever faster as in an instant, the blazing fiery star that enclosed Noah's figure bypassed the fiery Dream Essence breath and appeared before the jaws of the Gynosphinx.
But the charge didn't stop.

The Blitzkrieg wasn't halted for even a microsecond as Dream Extermination Flames and volatile rays of light surged out, the Innate Barrier around the Gynosphinx buzzing and trembling as it broke down and...!
SHAA!
The Unparalleled Emperor's Blitzkrieg passed through the body of the Gynosphinx.
Through the visage of the powerful Ultima Strata Dream LEGEND as its figure exploded and was burned by the Dream Extermination Flames soon after!
SHAA!

Millions more Dream and Nightmare LEGENDs that were on the Lemniscate path of this Blitzkrieg faced the same fate as this shocking action and sequence had caught the eyes of all beings on the battlefield.

This was because the form of a purple and gold infinity symbol had been carved out on the Legions of the Dimensional existences, covering over one-tenth of the vast sea of black and white closest to the Primordial Legions as within a matter of a few microseconds, the Lemniscate was nearly complete!

An Ultima Strata LEGEND had stood within its way and perished as it carved its unstoppable path, a foreboding feeling welling in the destinies of nearby Ultima Nightmares when they saw this Lemniscate about to complete.
Three more Ultima Strata LEGENDs surged forward in to stop its advancement as wondrously, it was too fast.

The path of the Unparalleled Emperor's Blitzkrieg was completed just as they were a few light years away, Noah returning to the position he started as when the DHARMIC forms of purple and gold met, a sound akin to a gate closing rang out.
The symphony came to a halt.
The radiant infinity symbol of purple and gold began to blaze with light as it erupted with a shocking Gravitational force!
The last phase of the <Unparalleled Emperor's Blitzkrieg> was being enacted!

The completed Infinity symbol that had burned everything in its path while it was being etched released a horrific Gravitational pull as there were still Dream and Nightmare LEGENDs in even larger numbers within the two circles of this Lemniscate.
These Dimensional existences were drawn in.

Those outside of this Lemniscate for tens of light years were also drawn to it as the three Ultima Strata LEGENDs that wanted to stop it also faced an astounding Gravitational pull that they couldn't deny!

Dream Extermination Flames burned brightly as the entrenched infinity symbol of the Unparalleled Emperor's Blitzkrieg began to shine with an explosive light after pulling in as many nearby enemies as possible, a soul rending explosion booming out along with the resumption of a shocking symphony!
BOOOOOM!

Sending the obscene danger and Damage Values that reached half a Trillion, the Gynosphinx that was already moving after Noah saw his charge into their Legions as its figure flashed.

An Alpha Strata LEGEND that would have met with Noah's charge exploded into pure Dream Essence as the Gynosphinx appeared in its place, Seas of Dream Essence surging and forming into golden wings of blinding light that reinforced the Gynosphinx as its jaws opened to release a breath of pure Dream Essence.
Towards the shining star coming his way.

The surge of flaming Dream Essence smashed onto the path of the Unparalleled Emperor's Blitzkrieg as wondrously, they were absorbed and dissipated by the Dream Extermination Flames as the charge continued.
Towards the Gynosphinx that had put itself on the path of this charge.
WA!
WA!
WA!
The symphony paved ever faster as in an instant, the blazing fiery star that enclosed Noah's figure bypassed the fiery Dream Essence breath and appeared before the jaws of the Gynosphinx.
But the charge didn't stop.

The Blitzkrieg wasn't halted for even a microsecond as Dream Extermination Flames and volatile rays of light surged out, the Innate Barrier around the Gynosphinx buzzing and trembling as it broke down and...!
SHAA!
The Unparalleled Emperor's Blitzkrieg passed through the body of the Gynosphinx.
Through the visage of the powerful Ultima Strata Dream LEGEND as its figure exploded and was burned by the Dream Extermination Flames soon after!
SHAA!

Millions more Dream and Nightmare LEGENDs that were on the Lemniscate path of this Blitzkrieg faced the same fate as this shocking action and sequence had caught the eyes of all beings on the battlefield.

This was because the form of a purple and gold infinity symbol had been carved out on the Legions of the Dimensional existences, covering over one-tenth of the vast sea of black and white closest to the Primordial Legions as within a matter of a few microseconds, the Lemniscate was nearly complete!

An Ultima Strata LEGEND had stood within its way and perished as it carved its unstoppable path, a foreboding feeling welling in the destinies of nearby Ultima Nightmares when they saw this Lemniscate about to complete.
Three more Ultima Strata LEGENDs surged forward in to stop its advancement as wondrously, it was too fast.

The path of the Unparalleled Emperor's Blitzkrieg was completed just as they were a few light years away, Noah returning to the position he started as when the DHARMIC forms of purple and gold met, a sound akin to a gate closing rang out.
The symphony came to a halt.
The radiant infinity symbol of purple and gold began to blaze with light as it erupted with a shocking Gravitational force!
The last phase of the <Unparalleled Emperor's Blitzkrieg> was being enacted!

The completed Infinity symbol that had burned everything in its path while it was being etched released a horrific Gravitational pull as there were still Dream and Nightmare LEGENDs in even larger numbers within the two circles of this Lemniscate.
These Dimensional existences were drawn in.

Those outside of this Lemniscate for tens of light years were also drawn to it as the three Ultima Strata LEGENDs that wanted to stop it also faced an astounding Gravitational pull that they couldn't deny!

Dream Extermination Flames burned brightly as the entrenched infinity symbol of the Unparalleled Emperor's Blitzkrieg began to shine with an explosive light after pulling in as many nearby enemies as possible, a soul rending explosion booming out along with the resumption of a shocking symphony!
BOOOOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 1961
paragraphs: A carved infinity symbol pulled its enemies with a shocking pull of gravity and exploded out maddeningly in the next instant.
In the Dimensional Holy Land of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality, Noah saw the results of this first hand as the reason for all this made itself apparent.
The allure of loot...showed itself.
<+50,000 Ultima Blood Pearls have been obtained...> DING! The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...<+500 Empyral Physique Refining Pearls obtained.>
<+50,000 Plasmoid Soul Drops have been obtained...> DING! The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...<+500 Plasmoid Soul Seas have been obtained.>
The loot from only the Ultima Strata LEGENDs that had perished under him showed as next, the combined count of Grotto Panaceas from both Ultima and Alpha Strata LEGENDS showed.
<+225 Reality Panaceas have been obtained...> DING! The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...<+225 Grotto Panaceas have been obtained.>
<435 Kainos Dimensional Resource points have been obtained....>
<The effects of Absolute Looter are applied.>
<You have attained 675 Shards of Profundity that contain the musings of the Decretum of Dreams...>
Fantastical prompts had flashed before his eyes as they meant a great deal of things.
Many of them would have tremendously important uses and take Noah far, but nothing was as fantastical as the highest tiered loot under Noah at this moment.
The Grotto Panaceas!
A total of 67 Grotto Panaceas were required for the full saturation of the Second Dimensional Layer.

With the cast of the Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique- Second Form, Noah had taken down multiple Ultima Strata LEGENDs and over a hundred at the Alpha Strata as the Grotto Panaceas he attained were enough to accomplish many things!

225 Grotto Panaceas were entirely enough to fully saturate Noah's Second Layer and get started with the third one, with the major question waiting for him being the cost of elevation for the Third Dimensional Layer.
From the first to the second, the effectiveness of Grotto Panaceas was halved from 3 Trillion to 1.5 Trillion Kainos Royal Cosmos.

Going into the Third Layer...would 1.5 be halved again or since the difficulty continued to rise even higher as Noah forged more Dimensions, would the effectiveness of Grotto Panaceas be divided even more?!
Noah's destiny told him he would not like the answer.
And the affirmation came soon after!
<The Grotto Panacea knows itself and its usage very well.>
WAA!
Essence buzzed around Noah as the 225 Grotto Panaceas within his Expansive Space all shone with boundless luminescence.

<The Grotto Panacea regrets to inform you that for your Third Dimensional Layer, it can only form 375 Billion Kainos Royal Cosmos. Its abilities being decreased fourfold isn't due to its weakness, but due to the path you chose where obscene amounts of resources are required the further up you traverse on this path.>
The Tri-Pupiled eyes of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor released blinding beams of light as his path was made clear!
The effectiveness of the Grotto Panaceas was halved from the First to the Second Dimensional Layer, and then their effectiveness was further decreased fourfold from the Second to the Third Layer!
He needed 267 Grotto Panaceas to complete the Third Dimensional Layer.

With what Noah had on hand...it meant he could fully finish his Second Layer and get started with his Third, and he would no doubt have enough to complete that Layer so long as he repeated what he just did in this war.
But of course, it didn't end there.
<The Grotto Panacea has made further calculations.>

<It states that there is a high probability that from the Third to the Fourth Layer, its effectiveness will be reduced 8 fold. For your Fourth Dimensional Layer, it can only form 47 Billion Kainos Royal Cosmos.>
The path he had chosen for himself gradually became clear.
He would require 2128 Grotto Panaceas to fully forge his Fourth Dimensional Layer!
And if the sequence continued like this...
<The Grotto Panacea affirms that from the Fourth to the Fifth Layer, its effectiveness will be reduced 16-fold. For your Fifth Dimensional Layer, it can only form 2.9 Billion Kainos Royal Cosmos.>
WAA!
Noah's luminous fade gradually became dimmer as he contained his will.
He knew his path would be hard but this...
He would need approximately 34,482 Grotto Panaceas just to complete his Fifth Dimensional Layer!
The difference from the requirements to complete the first to the Fifth were just that drastic.
<The Grotto Panacea has made further calcu->
"Stop it."
Noah's will surged out to stop the ridiculous Loot from making any further calculations.
He got the idea.
The Sixth to Ninth and final Dimensional would take insurmountable resources to forge as he didn't even need to think about this right now.
He only needed to gaze at what was right in front of him.
The idea was already cemented in stone as all that it meant was that many, many of his enemies would have to perish for him to accomplish what he sought!
And wondrously, he would be becoming an Enemy of multiple Dimensions the more Dimensions he forged as sources of loot would not stop!

So he did what he could do now as he called out tens of Grotto Panaceas, the radiant Loot unfurling and showering his main body with their light as hundreds of Billions of Kainos Royal Prana Cosmos bloomed.
The halfway point would be reached soon enough as his power would explode even further, with the finality of this Second Dimensional Layer not being too far away!
His mind settled as he experienced his shocking growth unique to him.
Who else could explosively grow their power in the middle of a battle by devouring everything about the enemies they killed? Who else but the Quintessential Kainos Emperor?!

He devoured the aspects of his enemies and multiplied them with the Resplendent Treasure Emperor, and there were still even more boons as the last set of prompts after the Grotto Panaceas and Dimensional Resource Points came down.
They were normally the prompts about concepts and edicts, but this time...
<You have eradicated an existence(s) with a fully completed HERESY Tier Concept while holding understanding in this same Decretum of said concept.>
<You have attained the HERESY Edicts of the Slumbering Dreamer and The Nightmare of the Endless Seas.>

chapters.title: Chapter 1962
paragraphs: HERESY.
Concepts infused with the Essence of a Decretum of a Dimension!

There were preconditions to be met in order for one to attain such concepts as if Noah eradicated an existence that had such a concept but not the Decretum utilized for it...how would it even be capable of utilization?
Today, some of the Ultima Strata existences he had taken down had fully formed HERESEY concepts as since they were based on the Decretum of Dreams, Noah got his hands on them!
The Slumbering Dreamer and The Nightmare of the Endless Seas!
Noah's will surged to unfurl these new concepts while in the region of the Boundary Between Realities where 5 Grotto Haven Suzerains faced the Nightwalker, events continued to unfold.
100 Million Units of the Essence of Reality was a lot.
It was the maximum number for many beings even in the Ultima and weaker Grotto Haven as when utilizing their essence, nobody would be so wasteful as to use it all right away!
If one didn't have any Essence of Reality to pull from, they may have just placed themselves on the path of death.
So even in large-scale battles, nobody would go out of their way to expend all of their energy in mere microseconds- much less when the battle had only just begun.
This was the norm.

Then, there was the inexplicable situation unfolding before everyone's eyes right now as due to the recent domineering actions of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor, even the gazes of Suzerains turned towards his direction!
Grotto Haven Suzerains were powerful and feared for their battle power.

The Dream Master Nightwalker was even more feared among Suzerains as 5 Grotto Haven Primordial Suzerains were mobilized to keep him down and potentially push him back, with Suzerain Jiyeon being the last piece that helped tilt the battle towards the favor of Primordials in this region!

Yet now...a new variable entered the picture as it was just an obscene and incomprehensible variable to look at, and as such...this being drew the attention of the major powerhouses of this battlefield.

As the Infinity symbol of the Unparalleled Emperor's Blitzkrieg shattered, only destruction lay in its wake as amidst the spatial storms and destroyed space, the figure of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor was all that remained.
His dark hair danced around his head like tendrils of lightning, his body wrapped around with an armament that swirled with rivers of reality.
He looked like an ancient warrior from a past Age as abundant life force and the essence of Natural Laws danced around him!
And around him, as clear as day, a tenth of the sea of gold and black that represented Dream and Nightmare LEGENDs had been utterly erased.
5 Ultima Strata existences were in this space as they had fallen.
Over 100 Alpha Strata monstrosities were eradicated.
The hundreds of millions of those below this stage also faced their death!
The battling Suzerains turned their eyes in this direction.
The massive Dream Master, The Nightwalker...it turned its many and constantly shifting eyes in this direction.
They all focused on a single being who was in the center of this destruction.
A being who was now enclosed within the sea of black and gold as he was separated from the Primordial Legions.

Maybe he could pull back and easily join the Legions under the protection of Ultima Strata Commanders and a Suzerain, but under the gaze of all beings...his mesmerizing form came out of its stance as his hair danced wildly, and his figure began to surge forward.
Not towards the Legions of Primordials to rejoin his forces, but towards the empty space of destruction where further away, the rising clusters of Dream and Nightmare LEGENDs could be seen.

After such a shocking attack that would have no doubt spent the reserves of any Ultima Strata LEGEND and taken them out of circulation, this being was actually undaunted as he even charged towards the depths of the enemy Legions alone!
This action made one feel an inexplicable sense of loss, as if they were watching a shining star of a rising hero in its last moments.
A star that shone the brightest before it was utterly extinguished.

Suzerain Jiyeon saw these scene of this young genius charging into the depths of the Legions of Dimensional existences after casting an ability way outside his horizons, eradicating a tenth of the massive army as at this moment- it seemed like he was rushing towards the enemies to accept a valiant death!
'Why must the geniuses always be the dumbest beings?! You could have worked with Ultima Strata Commanders and kept your life, not just sacrifice it in a single battle!'
WAA!
She moved to try and save this being that had taken a shocking action.
But...
SHIING!

The Nightwalker moved at the same time as even while facing 4 others, this Dream Master still comfortably kept Suzerain Jiyeon in check as she wouldn't be able to save the shining star that was like a moth rushing to the flames.
No Dimensional Existences surged towards this existence en masse.
They knew that a wounded and spent beast would release their deadliest attack before they perished as they were all just shown his powerful attack that wiped out 5 Ultima Strata LEGENDs!

So instead, multiple auras of powerful Ultima Strata Dream and Nightmare LEGENDs rose and surged towards him as the empty and destructive space he had carved out with the explosion of the infinity symbol forged from the Unparalleled Emperor's Blitzkrieg remained unfilled by the sea of black and gold.
It showed his lone moving figure as powerful combatants under the Dream Master moved to contain and finish him as he was in his 'weakest' state!
HOONG!
A low but throbbing symphony indicating things were not done began to play.
"Alexander!"

In the distance, Representative Aileron was burning with a light of a Natural Law of Reality as he tried to forge forward, but an Ultima Strata LEGEND stood in his path as he could only be rebuffed and watch.
Among all those gazing at this scene with shock and regret, a few did not as their eyes were instead filled with expectations.
One of them was the Mirror Clone of Katelyn which had her main body Dual Cultivating with Noah at this moment, and the other was Akaris.
The little that they knew about Noah, they knew that he wouldn't sacrifice himself. If he was rushing towards the depths of the enemy Legions...
It meant a grand show was about to play as at his shining figure that many assumed to be living its last moments...a light of radiance bloomed as his empty hands came to grasp weapons.
The Emperor's Ruined Blade of Oblivion and the Atlatl of Reality.
An Atlatl that apart from the myriad of Realities, it also now carried the weight of a portion of a budding Dimension within the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.

The stellar spear buzzed with light as the Quintessential Kainos Emperor hurled it towards the direction of one Ultima Strata, the Emperor's Ruined Blade of Oblivion pointing to the others as a shining Star of Illumination manifested above Noah, and then beside this star- a curvaceous Saintess of Fiery Damnation rose with an enticing light!
This wasn't all maddening devilish essence erupted, the visage of Bloodfiend becoming called out as the Assassin Emperor of Severance also appeared in its REIFIED form.

Just when others expected to see a shining star be extinguished, this star shattered apart any known norms as it didn't seem like someone that had just spent a vast majority of their resources to pull off a shocking feat.
It instead seemed like someone that was just getting started as he actually targeted and faced 5 oncoming Ultima Strata Dreams and Nightmares that knew of his power single handedly!

paragraphs: Intimidating.
This was the only word that could describe Noah's fearless advancement as he called out multiple REIFIED abilities towards 5 Ultima Strata LEGENDs!
But the situation had changed.
They knew the possible level of power he could display and the fact that he had just eradicated 5 others just like them.

These were Ultima Strata Nightmares and Dream Lineages who were currently drenched in the Decretum of Dreams as their eyes shone with malice and power- some of the more powerful Ultima Strata Commanders among these Legions!
Their Damage Values weren't the initial 100 Billion benchmark of their stage.
It was in the hundreds of Billions!
So against Noah's REIFIED abilities that currently deal an upwards of 170 Billion Damage Values...
BOOOM!

A fantastical scene of the dissolution of REIFIED abilities bloomed as the Assassin Emperor of Severance, Saintess of Fiery Damnation, and the rising Bloodfiend with its devilish essence felt stupendous opposition that didn't leave them on the battlefield for too long!

Only the First Form of the Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique remained above Noah as it shot out rays of blinding light, the Mirror effect of the Emperor's Ruined Blade of Annihilation triggering after the first round of attacks as another round of Assassin Emperors of Severance surged out- targeting all 5 enemies coming towards Noah as they were kept at bay.
But these were still Nightmares and Dreams that had lived for Millions of years.
When they were fighting for their lives and not underestimating the enemy before them...they moved like the old monsters they were.
SHAA!
One of the most powerful out of the Ultima Strata LEGENDS was an Oinoloth.

A nightmare whose whole body seemed to be made of puss and boils as pestilence and terror reeked from its body, elongated arms with sharp nails that were disproportionate to its whole body shining with a maddening Obsidian sandy light.
This Oinoloth erupted with the Decretum of Dreams and instantly appeared behind Noah, its elongated nails shining with sandy black malice as they smashed towards his head.
BZZT!
At attack equivalent to approximately 400 Billion Damage Values as it was potent with the Decretum of Dreams.
And ridiculously...it was rebuffed from ever reaching the visage of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor as the allure of a dazzling Innate Dimensional Barrier flashed!
The Innate Dimensional Barrier!
Noah could barely dish out a bit over 170 Billion+ Damage Values, but his defense was many levels higher as his Innate Dimensional Barrier was 400% of his maximum possible Defense Values.
This was close to 700 Billion Dimensional Defense Values as the Ascendant Lich's Armament of Devotion pushed his defenses close to 900 Billion.
That was how sturdy Noah's defenses had grown.
This...was an area that granted him a level of confidence!
So when a Nightmare appeared behind him in close quarters and actually came in contact with his Barrier, it was rebuffed effortlessly as Noah didn't let this chance slip by.
SHAA!

As if his will had captured everything as it occurred, his hand reached out behind him the moment the Oinoloth was rebuffed as without caring for the amalgamation of puss and monstrosities that made this creature, his right hand grabbed onto it as the maddening pull of the Essence of Gravitation surged around him.

His whole body then turned as his eyes shone with a devilish light, his left hand also coming around with its own gravitational pull as it wielded the Emperor's Ruined Blade of Oblivion that shot towards the body of this Nightmare!

This Nightmare that had begun to feel its destiny buzzing fearfully as it stared into the Tri-Pupiled eyes of this shocking existence that forcefully kept it close, the mesmerizing dark hair of this devilish being dancing madly as before the Emperor's Ruined Blade of Oblivion could even arrive, his mouth opened as he bellowed out while releasing horrendous waves of his will.
"OOOOOH!"
Emperor's Haki.
With essence buzzing wildly around him, Noah bellowed out in the face of this Nightmare as it faced 170 Billion right before its eyes.
The Emperor's Ruined Blade of Oblivion was timed perfectly on the left hand as it arrived at the same time as the waves of Haki reverberating out- that was another 170 Billion.

Then from the right hand of Noah that grasped onto this being tightly with its own Gravitational force- it had beckoned the weapon it had before to return as the Atlatl of Reality appeared behind the head of this Nightmare to simultaneously land on it at the same instant as the bellowing yell of Haki and the strike from the Emperor's Ruined Blade of Oblivion!
Three attacks that easily toppled 500 Billion landed instantly- and this was even before the Mirror effect of the Emperor's Ruined Blade of Oblivion was triggered!
The result...
BOOM...SQUELCH!

The Innate Dimensional Barrier of this Nightmare was shattered as two terrifying weapons sank into it, the bellowing yell of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor smashing into its puss-filled body as whatever remnants of Aspects of Existence it held...were blown away from Noah and turned into Obsidian waves of dust!
Dust.
This was all that remained of the powerful Ultima Strata Nightmare that had rushed into close combat with Noah.
Even as its elongated claws were struggling against him near the end, it couldn't get past Noah's ridiculous defenses!
So its Innate Dimensional Barrier was worn down as its True Dimensional Vitality Values were ground to dust along with its whole body soon after!
The remaining 4 Ultima Strata LEGENDs halted for a brief millisecond at this scene of carnage and brutality.
Yes.
Against an Ultima Strata existence- the way that he was handled bordered on brutality!

The wild waves of essence around Noah caused the 4 remaining Ultima Strata existences to stay away from him as their eyes became even sharper and graver, opting for long-distance attacks instead as the second strongest Ultima Strata LEGEND within this group moved.
It was a Dream LEGEND as this being's body coagulated to form a majestic golden jellyfish.
Its tendrils shone with a shocking soul light as this was an existence from a Lineage of creatures with heavy proficiency in the Soul.
Seeing the progression and might of this being, it instantly utilized its ultimate skill which was based purely on the soul!
"Dream Imprisonment!"
HUUM!

This was the only word that could describe Noah's fearless advancement as he called out multiple REIFIED abilities towards 5 Ultima Strata LEGENDs!
But the situation had changed.
They knew the possible level of power he could display and the fact that he had just eradicated 5 others just like them.

These were Ultima Strata Nightmares and Dream Lineages who were currently drenched in the Decretum of Dreams as their eyes shone with malice and power- some of the more powerful Ultima Strata Commanders among these Legions!
Their Damage Values weren't the initial 100 Billion benchmark of their stage.
It was in the hundreds of Billions!
So against Noah's REIFIED abilities that currently deal an upwards of 170 Billion Damage Values...
BOOOM!

A fantastical scene of the dissolution of REIFIED abilities bloomed as the Assassin Emperor of Severance, Saintess of Fiery Damnation, and the rising Bloodfiend with its devilish essence felt stupendous opposition that didn't leave them on the battlefield for too long!

Only the First Form of the Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique remained above Noah as it shot out rays of blinding light, the Mirror effect of the Emperor's Ruined Blade of Annihilation triggering after the first round of attacks as another round of Assassin Emperors of Severance surged out- targeting all 5 enemies coming towards Noah as they were kept at bay.

chapters.title: Chapter 1964
paragraphs: An attack of the soul.

Formless and not actually holding any damage Values, it was an Ultimate attack of the Golden Dream Jellyfish that simply drew one's will into a Dreamscape as the stronger soul out of the two would be the one to leave out of this space alive!
This was <Dream Imprisonment>.

The only downside to it was one's physical body would be at the mercy of others during it, but this was the same for its enemy as the Golden Dream Jellyfish let its will be known to its three remaining compatriots to fully eradicate this being's other aspects of Existence as it handled its soul!

The Imprisonment in the Dreamscape should be held for as long as his soul could handle as after that, the Origin and Body of this being should also be taken care of by the remaining three Ultima Strata Commanders.
SHAA!

The soul and vision of the Golden Dream Jellyfish flashed as a glorious golden light was reflected on the visage of Noah that was wondrously...stopped on the outside of the Innate Dimensional Barrier briefly.
It was supposed to be an ultimate attack of a race that superseded an Innate Dimensional Barrier, and yet it seemed different when targeted towards someone this tyrannical.
But the eyes of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor flashed as the golden light was allowed in right after!
In a newly formed Dreamscape that shone with auroras of gold.
The Golden Dream Jellyfish opened its eyes in this newly enacted space where time flowed much, much differently than the outside world.
Here, a creature like it proficient in the soul was a master.
It gazed around as it couldn't locate its enemy, only seeing a curtain of golden light in front of it!
A curtain?
The Will of the Golden Dream Jellyfish blinked as it gazed up this curtain.
Its visage then began to tremble.

It wasn't a curtain. It was the mere visage of a leg that rose up to reveal a massive golden stellar soul form of an existence whose Tri-Pupiled eyes were gazing down at the minuscule size and form of the Golden Dream Jellyfish as their size discrepancy...showed the gap in the soul strength between them!
The Ultima Strata Golden Dream Jellyfish trembled at such a sight as it held disbelief and incredulity!
It...was supposed to be the one from the Lineage of beings who were supremely proficient in the soul, right?
Yet the gaze of the Tri-Pupiled Kainos Emperor above it was filled with disdain and tyranny as a soul shaking voice boomed out from him.
"Pathetic."
BOOM...CRACK!
The Dreamscape instantly crumbled along with a terrified and disbelieving soul.
It didn't even take a fourth of a microsecond in the outside space.

The <Dream Imprisonment> shattered as the Dream that had cast it suffered immeasurable soul damage, the Golden Dream Jellyfish splitting apart as Noah only gazed at it while sending his thought in the form of Haki reverberating outwards!

And the already greatly injured soul trembled as it faced utter eradication soon after, disbelief on its very soul present as it couldn't fathom how this existence before it had such an immensely strong soul that it had only seen a glimpse of from those above it in power.
PA!
The Aspects of Existence that made the Golden Dream Jellyfish shattered.
Another Ultima Strata existence fell.

The other three that had received the words of the Jellyfish to attack Noah while he contained his soul hadn't even finished their moves when this said ally perished while their enemy regained his will too quickly!
WAA!
And his eyes of devilishness and brutality turned back towards them as the Quintessential Kainos Emperor moved towards the remaining 3 without fear.
"OOOH!"
A bellow of Haki boomed out from him ridiculously as he seemed to have inexhaustible energy, sweeping towards his enemies with shocking momentum as he seemed unstoppable!
As he seemed dominant against these Ultima Strata LEGENDs as none of them could even hurt him to break his Innate Dimensional Barrier.
For it to be broken, an instantaneous Damage Value of 900+ Billion had to land on Noah as if this wasn't breached, he would remain untouched!
"What the hell..."

The existences that were waiting to see a hero's sacrifice blinked in disbelief at the scene occurring as Representative Aileron and his Nightmare enemy had stopped their deadly blows briefly to watch this scene.
There was an uproar in the minds of all these beings at this display of power!
"Inexhaustible display of concepts! Is this being holding extreme attainments in Manadynamics?!"
A roaring cry of disbelief in one area.
"Is the information right? Is this really the genius who was known to have Alpha Strata battle power?"
Those privy to the people and events in the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest also spoke out their disbelief.
"Alpha Strata? Are you sure he isn't on the cusp of Grotto Haven?!"
An Ultima Strata Dragon Phoenix in distance gazed with shock and a hint of envy as he led his Legions to defend, this scene capturing the eyes and hearts of too many beings!
This scene...that was also becoming increasingly important to the massive visages of Suzerains that were fighting in the central locations of this battlefield.
As Commanders of all these Legions, they knew very well how the battles against their Ultima Strata Commanders went!
They were supposed to take time wearing each other down as the most powerful would trump the other and their Legions in the end.
The key here was that it was supposed to take time.

This being before them was disrupting the whole battlefield with a shocking momentum as he ripped through Ultima Strata LEGENDs in microseconds as he showed dominance and invincibility that shouldn't be possible unless he was at the utmost peak of Ultima Strata or getting close to the Grotto Haven Realm!
They had this shocking thought, but they weren't entirely correct.
At this second, Noah was still barely a fourth of the way in the Ultima Strata Stage in terms of maximum Damage Values.
It was his unique concepts, abilities, and the fact that he could spam them freely that gave the illusion of much more battle power and made him seem like the untouchable Ultima Strata expert!
Of course, his battle power would be changing rapidly in the seconds to come as his main body accomplished something others couldn't even imagine.
Yet even now, he showed the undaunted might of an existence that was unmatched in the Ultima Strata.
An expert...that might not be capable of being brought down by other Ultima Stratas.

It meant that as all the Suzerains turned their wills towards him, one particularly powerful Suzerain did so as well- this being the one who was powerful enough to be held back by 5 others at the same stage as him!
The Dream Master that had been controlling the battlefield this whole time.
The Nightwalker.
Seeing the unfolding scene, this being made a decision!
In the past Ages and Eras, many geniuses rose and fell as there were a few unique geniuses and existences that experienced fortuitous encounters and attained powers unique to them.
Existences who stood above others in power or survivability as in any age, their destiny shone brightly.
Some were known as Chosen Emperors.
Others did not hold a particular title.
There were a few such beings at any given Age who showed exceptional power, with many of them hiding it and not displaying it to others.
Experiencing profound fortune and providence...one such being was the Nightwalker.

His constantly changing apparition of a humanoid Nightmare stopped fluctuating and gradually became solidified as his will gazed upon the Grotto Haven Suzerains it had been facing this whole time and the constantly changing battlefield that was being led by the nose of a single new entrant.
Thereafter...
HUUUM!
The surroundings began to shake and tremble as torrential waves of Obsidian and golden sandy flames began to rage around a particularly unique Dream Master!

chapters.title: Chapter 1965
paragraphs: The weaving of destiny was unique as it didn't particularly favor any being over others.

Those who had great destinies and high quantified fate or destiny values could understand the weaving of destiny better and navigate it with a level of control, but even they were existences who could have their destiny meet an abysmal end at any point in time.
There were Chosen Emperors...but even they still fell.
The Nightwalker kept this in mind during all his ventures as he was an extremely careful being!
He monitored the situation and forces of Primordials sent against him while carrying out the mission of locating the Dimensional Inimicus.

This mission alone was hard as even locating and knowing the target they sought right before them was nearly impossible unless the will of a Dimensional Ruler came in contact with the target- their closeness to the Latent Will of the Dream Dimension allowing them to sense the Dimensional Inimicus.
But for all others, it was the flip of a coin as due to this, they had the commands to raze down all Realities and existences they came across.
Because they did not know who their enemy was...just that he was in the Desolate Mausoleum.

So the Nightwalker followed the commands of the Dimensional Ruler he followed as after confirming the latest change of the battle to be a particularly unique existence that was tilting it'd favor and pace...he was finally ready to make a move.
The massive nightmarish sword he grasped buzzed as it released torrential flames of sandu black and gold light that wrapped around his body.

The fortune that had gotten him all the way here was this. A unique sword he found embedded in a domain field of Desolate essence in the Dream Dimension Billions of years ago. He had even hidden its uses from the Dimensional Ruler above him as he let some of its power loose at this moment!
BOOOM!

The torrential flames rose up like hellish mountains as Suzerain Jiyeon and the others had their expressions change, their bodies also lighting up brightly as a shocking change enveloped the battlefield.
From the soul shaking massive nightmarish sword that the Nightwalker held, waves of the Decretum of Dreams echoed out along with potent Absolute Dream Authority.
Potent was the word here.
Its effects were significant as it took the will of the Nightwalker from its Nightmares to portray them to Reality.
The many eyes of this being flashed as he made a move to simply complete the mission given to him with no ulterior motives, his only goal being to erase those who lay in his path!
The Primordial Suzerains were counted in this...as well as the newly appearing entrant that erased a tenth of his forces.
HUUUM!
A dangerous symphony pulsed.
And the Nightwalker spoke out as everything in the surroundings became enveloped by a blanket of torrential nightmarish obsidian and golden flames.
"Haven Shattering, Reality Collapsing."
The massive obsidian nightmarish sword swung down as like a key unlocking something, the Nightwalker turned it.
And then a cataclysm arrived as deadly beams of Nightmare Sword Flames surged out in the Trillions to blanket everything!
Most of them surged towards the 5 Suzerains, but a few streaked towards the prominent Ultima Strata Primordial Commanders, with a not insignificant amount surging towards Noah!
A field of black and gold sword flames that swathed the very void around it.
The Boundary Between Realities trembled and fissured as this cataclysmic essence wildly spread.

This was what the battlefield had turned into as even the empty area Noah had cleared became covered, these shocking Nightmare Sword Flames not discriminating between friend or foe as even the 3 remaining Ultima Strata existences Noah faced felt their hearts shudder!
'The one to cause all this...'
The Eyes of the Tri-Pupiled Kainos Emperor flashed as they gazed upon the powerful Dream Master.
Upon the Nightwalker.
<Name>: Suzerain Vovadan/The Nightwalker
<Lineage>: Imperial Nightmare Oneiric
<Realm>: Grotto Haven
<Titles>: Dream Walker, Terror Bringer...
<True Dimensional Vitality Values>: 17 Trillion
<Innate Dimensional Barrier>: 3 Trillion
<Reserves of Essence of Reality>: 250 Million
<Mana>: 2,500 Trillion
<Destiny>: 66 <Fate>: 66...
<Overall Battlepower>: Grotto Haven
Dreadful numbers rose before Noah's eyes as this wasn't the most pressing matter about the being he gazed at.
It was the fact that above his head, three exclamation marks were present!
'What the hell is this...?'
Noah's eyes shone with a profound interest in this time of great danger, focusing in on the prompt that was indecipherable while his will prompted Lavalliere.
From this unique treasure, Absolute Dream Authority flashed as Noah continued to give her the loot he wasn't in great need of that stemmed from Beta Strata existences and below.

<Your understanding of Destiny, Fate, Karma, and Fortune are increasing as they can lead you to truths and paths that may affect your own fortune. To fit your style, it seems to be displayed as exclamation marks that you'll have to use your own unique means to figure out. In this case, you utilized Absolute Dream Authority for the sake of speed. Your Tri-Pupiled eyes would have also been able to see the truth after a sufficient period of time.>

Lavalliere's mesmerizing voice echoed out as it seemed to be filled with more Vitality while her shackles continued to break, the result of utilizing Absolute Dream Authority to quickly gaze upon what was unique about the Enemy before them becoming clear.
<You have better understood the weaving of destiny.>
<You've discovered that an existence that holds a Destined Absolute Dimensional Relic. Taking the Relic from them and making it yours will vastly increase your Destiny and Fortune.>
<Discovered Destined Absolute Dimensional Relic- The Absolute Nightmare Sword.>
Magisterial new prompts rose as Noah felt the ringing of destiny buzz in his ears.
But...he would have to survive an onslaught of a maddened Dream Master wielding this very Relic against 5 others of the same Realm as some of its residual strikes even came towards him!

So the Nightwalker followed the commands of the Dimensional Ruler he followed as after confirming the latest change of the battle to be a particularly unique existence that was tilting it'd favor and pace...he was finally ready to make a move.
The massive nightmarish sword he grasped buzzed as it released torrential flames of sandu black and gold light that wrapped around his body.
The fortune that had gotten him all the way here was this.
A unique sword he found embedded in a domain field of Desolate essence in the Dream Dimension Billions of years ago.
He had even hidden its uses from the Dimensional Ruler above him as he let some of its power loose at this moment!
BOOOM!

The torrential flames rose up like hellish mountains as Suzerain Jiyeon and the others had their expressions change, their bodies also lighting up brightly as a shocking change enveloped the battlefield.
From the soul shaking massive nightmarish sword that the Nightwalker held, waves of the Decretum of Dreams echoed out along with potent Absolute Dream Authority.
Potent was the word here.
Its effects were significant as it took the will of the Nightwalker from its Nightmares to portray them to Reality.
The many eyes of this being flashed as he made a move to simply complete the mission given to him with no ulterior motives, his only goal being to erase those who lay in his path!
The Primordial Suzerains were counted in this...as well as the newly appearing entrant that erased a tenth of his forces.
HUUUM!
A dangerous symphony pulsed.
And the Nightwalker spoke out as everything in the surroundings became enveloped by a blanket of torrential nightmarish obsidian and golden flames.
"Haven Shattering, Reality Collapsing."
The massive obsidian nightmarish sword swung down as like a key unlocking something, the Nightwalker turned it.
And then a cataclysm arrived as deadly beams of Nightmare Sword Flames surged out in the Trillions to blanket everything!
Most of them surged towards the 5 Suzerains, but a few streaked towards the prominent Ultima Strata Primordial Commanders, with a not insignificant amount surging towards Noah!
A field of black and gold sword flames that swathed the very void around it.
The Boundary Between Realities trembled and fissured as this cataclysmic essence wildly spread.

This was what the battlefield had turned into as even the empty area Noah had cleared became covered, these shocking Nightmare Sword Flames not discriminating between friend or foe as even the 3 remaining Ultima Strata existences Noah faced felt their hearts shudder!
'The one to cause all this...'
The Eyes of the Tri-Pupiled Kainos Emperor flashed as they gazed upon the powerful Dream Master.
Upon the Nightwalker.
<Name>: Suzerain Vovadan/The Nightwalker
<Lineage>: Imperial Nightmare Oneiric
<Realm>: Grotto Haven
<Titles>: Dream Walker, Terror Bringer...
<True Dimensional Vitality Values>: 17 Trillion
<Innate Dimensional Barrier>: 3 Trillion
<Reserves of Essence of Reality>: 250 Million
<Mana>: 2,500 Trillion
<Destiny>: 66 <Fate>: 66...
<Overall Battlepower>: Grotto Haven
Dreadful numbers rose before Noah's eyes as this wasn't the most pressing matter about the being he gazed at.
It was the fact that above his head, three exclamation marks were present!
'What the hell is this...?'
Noah's eyes shone with a profound interest in this time of great danger, focusing in on the prompt that was indecipherable while his will prompted Lavalliere.
From this unique treasure, Absolute Dream Authority flashed as Noah continued to give her the loot he wasn't in great need of that stemmed from Beta Strata existences and below.
<Your understanding of Destiny, Fate, Karma, and Fortune are increasing as they can lead you to truths and paths that may affect your own fortune.
To fit your style, it seems to be displayed as exclamation marks that you'll have to use your own unique means to figure out.
In this case, you utilized Absolute Dream Authority for the sake of speed.
Your Tri-Pupiled eyes would have also been able to see the truth after a sufficient period of time.>

Lavalliere's mesmerizing voice echoed out as it seemed to be filled with more Vitality while her shackles continued to break, the result of utilizing Absolute Dream Authority to quickly gaze upon what was unique about the Enemy before them becoming clear.
<You have better understood the weaving of destiny.>
<You've discovered that an existence that holds a Destined Absolute Dimensional Relic.
Taking the Relic from them and making it yours will vastly increase your Destiny and Fortune.>
<Discovered Destined Absolute Dimensional Relic- The Absolute Nightmare Sword.>
Magisterial new prompts rose as Noah felt the ringing of destiny buzz in his ears.
But...he would have to survive an onslaught of a maddened Dream Master wielding this very Relic against 5 others of the same Realm as some of its residual strikes even came towards him!

chapters.title: Chapter 1966
paragraphs: Through an increased understanding of Destiny among others, Noah could see pertinent information that could affect his own destiny in a major way!
The only issue was that for the pertinent information this time around, it was about a Relic that was in the hands of a powerful being he couldn't even touch yet.
It was a question of whether he could survive the apocalyptic widespread area of effect attack this Grotto Haven Dream Master had just thrown out, much less steal anything from it.
And the only way to do this was of course...his own power.
During this same period of time in the Dimensional Holy Land, Noah's progress in the Second Dimensional Layer exceeded the 50 Trillion Kainos Royal Prana Cosmos.
The center of the Dimensional Holy Land was brimming with life force.

The verdant light emanating from Noah was immense and tyrannical as his body surged with life, giving off a sense of an unshakable being with an unreasonable force of life that would be hard to eradicate!
And this became even more pronounced as the True Vitality Values that had been rising this whole time exploded upwards.
Prompts rose before his eyes as he passed the halfway mark and continued even further.
<Your Maximum Reserves of the Essence of Reality have risen to 225 Million.>
<Your Maximum Reserves of Prana Essence have risen to 1 Billion.>
<The Paramount Kainos Prana Dimensional Reality now grants 60,000 base boosts to Damage and Defense Values, bringing your Overall Origin Base Value to 140,000.>
<Your rate of Progression in the Decretum of Prana has increased by 100,000%>
<Your understanding of the Decretum of Prana has been forcefully increased to 12.5%>
<Your Maximum True Vitality Values have risen to 200 Billion.>
Incandescent swirls of essence surrounded his body at this juncture, his reserves of the Essence of Reality filling up as his life force was abundant!

Unlike the boosts of the First Dimensional Layer, his Reserves of the Essence of Reality were increased by 50 Million instead of 25, and his True Vitality Values ridiculously jumped 100 Billion all at once compared to the 25 Billion at the halfway mark of the First Dimensional Layer!

Of course, there was also the forceful elevation of the Decretum of Prana to 12.5% as among many other boosts, there was the Augmentation of 125% ready to be added to the 250% of the Decretum of Dreams and the percentages from Manadynamics, Gravitation, and Polarity that would inflate his Damage Values, Defense Values, and True Vitality Values even higher!
He was growing ever so steadily.
And because he had the resources within his hands, his body didn't stop blooming with Billions more Kainos Royal Prana Cosmos as full completion would not be too far away!
And as he achieved his goals...
<An Impossible Achievement!>
<You have been labeled as the Dimensional Inimicus by the Latent Will of the Prana Dimension...!>
In a domain of resplendent green.
Mystical floating Groves of thick vegetation floated in Seas of verdant essence, thick coiling roots occasionally rising and falling within this green sea.

Potent essence of the Decretum of Prana surged in the surroundings as the densest cluster was around a massive stellar tree that rose from the verdant sea and continued upwards across space endlessly!

The area above the green sea was filled with tendrils of green clouds as the radiant branches and leaves of this massive tree could barely be seen here, each leaf shimmering with the allure of multiple Realities.
HUUM!
The leaves of this massive tree that seemed like their own domains shook at this moment as the Essence of the Decretum of Prana surged all around this area...and the whole Prana Dimension!
A Latent will surged into the massive and ancient tree as its leaves fluttered.
"Dimensional Inimicus..."
A booming voice filled with age and vicissitude surged out as it seemed calm and collected even as the Latent Will of the Prana Dimension informed it with a sense of rage and urgency.
"First the Dream Dimension...and now the Prana Dimension."
The voice seemed tired and yet full of life, filled with care and love for life as rage was not felt within it!
"They said this would be an impossibility...and yet it is occurring."
WAA!
It seemed to speak of unknown things and mystical secrets.

Even though the Will of its Dimension urged it to do something as it felt other Dimensional Rulers within this Dimension about to move...this existence actually went in an opposite direction as <Absolute Prana Authority> surged from it, reaching far and wide as it went towards Four other Dimensional Rulers of the Prana Dimension!
<Do not make any moves.>
A shocking command from a supremely powerful Dimensional Ruler!
Other Dimensions had Dimensional Rulers and Dimensional Hellion Rulers who fought with each other for Hegemony or simply ruled their domains.
Then there were some unique Dimensions like Prana.
It was untouched by Dimensional Hellion Rulers as it remained unblemished from outside sources.
Part of the reason for this...was an ancient Dimensional Ruler who was rumored to have lived for as long as the Dimension itself.
A Dimensional Ruler that could actually control the other Dimensional Rulers of the Prana Dimension...and such an existence did not directly follow the will of the Prana Dimension at this moment!
The Essence of the Decretum of Prana surged...but no movements were made.
Destiny weaved as time flowed.
Back in the Boundary Between Realities, in a small section of the invading forces of the Dream Dimension.

In the battlefield where the Nightwalker had unleashed the might of an apocalyptic Relic, countless Nightmare Sword Flames raged around as even the Suzerains felt a great level of danger while they tried to contain them!
A small residual number of these Nightmare Sword Flames whizzed towards Primordial Commanders as some surged towards Noah who wanted to finish the three Ultima Strata LEGENDs before him.
Against the residual strikes of a Grotto Haven that could potentially reach 1 Trillion or even higher if he faced them head on, he actually smiled.
This was because at the halfway completion of his Second Dimensional Layer, his maximum Reserves of the Essence of Reality were raised by a whole 50 Million. But this wasn't all.
During this process, his dried up reserves remained dry no longer.
During his advancement...he actually had complete Regeneration of his Maximum Reserves of the Essence of Reality that now totaled 225 Million!
So in this increasingly chaotic battle that had turned utterly dangerous, a smile was etched on his face as he whispered calmly.
"Second Form."
HUUM!
His body began to buzz with a luminous light as the Unparalleled Emperor's Blitzkrieg was launched once more!

The symphony in the surrounding buzzed madly and with fervor as he turned into a luminous burning star that charged towards his enemies, intent on using the Damage Values of this attack ability, his Innate Dimensional Barrier, and Lich's Armament of Devotion to both kill and withstand the wild area of effect attack by a Grotto Haven Suzerain!
This was what Noah pulled out to withstand barely a fraction of the attack of the Nightwalker.
There were then the Primordial Grotto Haven Suzerains who had this attack focused on them.
The Nightwalker was especially cunning as he focused the largest cluster of the attack towards a Suzerain that could be considered the weakest!

In the void where the Suzerains fought, a Royal Human Suzerain let out a guttural yell and bellow as no dignity could be seen on his face that currently had rising terror in the onslaught of Absolute Dream Authority that was contained in the countless Nightmare Sword Flames surging towards it.
It was a terror stemming from the fear of Death as an unexpected result was blooming on this battlefield!
